We propose NextGen, a generative reranking framework for page-aware multi-objective recommendation under strict latency budgets. NextGen introduces three key designs: (1) a full-candidate autoregressive generative framework via a global context-aware Encoder-Decoder architecture that jointly optimizes page-level multiple objectives while autoregressively selecting items across the entire candidate set, rigorously constraining inference latency for real-time deployment; (2) a residual connection scheme for incremental reranking that feeds upstream ranking scores into both the item embedding layer and the candidate selection module, so the model only needs to predict nonlinear gains relative to ranking scores, improving convergence stability; (3) LLM-enhanced semantic embeddings from Taobao’s multimodal foundation model that enrich item representations with domain knowledge at no additional inference cost. Online A/B tests on Taobao Miaosha show that NextGen achieves +18.85% GMV and +12.35% order volume over the strongest baseline. The system is deployed in production, serving hundreds of millions of users daily.
papers.summary: 针对电商推荐重排序中现有生成式方法仅依赖下一曝光预测、忽视页面级多目标信号，且自回归解码延迟过高无法全候选打分的问题，本文提出NextGen生成式重排序框架。其核心设计包括：全局上下文感知的编码器-解码器架构，在严格延迟约束下自回归选择全候选商品并联合优化页面级多目标；残差连接方案将上游排序分数注入物品嵌入层和候选选择模块，使模型仅预测相对排序分数的非线性增益，提升收敛稳定性；利用淘宝多模态基座大模型生成LLM增强语义嵌入，在不增加推理成本下丰富物品表示。在淘宝秒杀场景的在线A/B测试中，NextGen相比最强基线实现GMV提升18.85%、订单量提升12.35%，系统已部署服务数亿日活用户。
papers.one_line_takeaway: NextGen通过全局上下文编码器-解码器、残差增量重排和LLM增强语义嵌入，在严格延迟下实现页面级多目标生成式重排序，线上GMV提升18.85%。
papers.core_method: 提出全候选自回归生成式重排序框架，采用全局上下文感知的编码器-解码器架构，联合优化页面级多目标（如总点击、总成交）并自回归选择全候选商品；引入残差连接方案，将上游排序分数注入物品嵌入层和候选选择模块，模型仅预测相对排序分数的非线性增益；使用淘宝多模态基座大模型生成LLM增强语义嵌入，不增加额外推理成本。
innovation_points: 全候选自回归生成式重排序框架，通过全局上下文编码器-解码器联合优化页面级多目标，并严格约束推理延迟以满足实时部署。
残差连接方案实现增量重排序，将上游排序分数注入嵌入层和选择模块，仅预测非线性增益，提升收敛稳定性。
利用淘宝多模态基座大模型生成LLM增强语义嵌入，以零额外推理成本丰富物品表示并注入领域知识。
experiment_results: 在淘宝秒杀场景的在线A/B测试中，相比最强基线，GMV提升18.85%，订单量提升12.35%。
系统已部署于生产环境，每日服务数亿用户。
limitations: 仅基于标题、摘要和学术元数据，未提供离线实验细节、延迟具体数值或消融研究。
未讨论框架在其他电商场景或非淘宝数据上的泛化能力。
未说明多目标权重调整或冷启动场景下的表现。
papers.practical_value: 为电商推荐重排序提供了一套可落地的生成式框架，在严格延迟约束下实现页面级多目标优化，并通过残差连接和LLM增强嵌入平衡效果与效率，已在大规模生产环境验证，对工业界推荐系统有直接参考价值。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作直面生成式重排序在工业部署中的两大痛点——监督信号局限和推理延迟，提出的全候选自回归框架、残差增量重排和LLM增强嵌入方案，在淘宝秒杀场景取得显著线上收益，为生成式推荐在真实业务中的落地提供了重要范例。

papers.title: Multi-Probe Zero Collision Hash (MPZCH): Mitigating Embedding Collisions and Enhancing Model Freshness in Large-Scale Recommenders
papers.abstract: Embedding tables are critical components of large-scale recommendation systems, facilitating the efficient mapping of high-cardinality categorical features into dense vector representations. However, as the volume of unique IDs expands, traditional hash-based indexing methods suffer from collisions that degrade model performance and personalization quality. We present Multi-Probe Zero Collision Hash (MPZCH), a novel indexing mechanism based on linear probing that effectively mitigates embedding collisions. With reasonable table sizing, it often eliminates these collisions entirely while maintaining production-scale efficiency. MPZCH utilizes auxiliary tensors and high-performance CUDA kernels to implement configurable probing and active eviction policies. By retiring obsolete IDs and resetting reassigned slots, MPZCH prevents the stale embedding inheritance typical of hash-based methods, ensuring new features learn effectively from scratch. Despite its collision-mitigation overhead, the system maintains training QPS and inference latency comparable to existing methods. Rigorous online experiments demonstrate that MPZCH achieves zero collisions for user embeddings and significantly improves item embedding freshness and quality. The solution has been released within the open-source TorchRec library for the broader community.
categories: Advanced Image and Video Retrieval Techniques
papers.summary: 针对大规模推荐系统中哈希索引导致的嵌入冲突和模型陈旧问题，本文提出多探针零冲突哈希（MPZCH）。MPZCH基于线性探测，利用辅助张量和CUDA核实现可配置探测与主动驱逐策略，在合理表大小下消除冲突，并淘汰过时ID、重置槽位，避免哈希方法中的陈旧嵌入继承。在线实验表明，用户嵌入实现零冲突，物品嵌入新鲜度和质量显著提升，训练QPS和推理延迟与现有方法相当。该方案已开源至TorchRec库。
papers.one_line_takeaway: MPZCH通过线性探测和主动驱逐，在保持生产级效率的同时消除嵌入冲突并提升模型新鲜度。
papers.core_method: 基于线性探测的索引机制，使用辅助张量和高性能CUDA核实现可配置探测与主动驱逐策略，淘汰过时ID并重置槽位。
innovation_points: 提出多探针零冲突哈希（MPZCH），在合理表大小下完全消除嵌入冲突。
引入主动驱逐策略，淘汰过时ID并重置槽位，防止陈旧嵌入继承。
利用辅助张量和CUDA核实现高效探测，保持训练QPS和推理延迟与现有方法相当。
在开源TorchRec库中发布，便于社区使用。
experiment_results: 在线实验表明，MPZCH实现用户嵌入零冲突。
物品嵌入新鲜度和质量显著提升。
训练QPS和推理延迟与现有方法相当。
limitations: 未提及具体数据集和详细实验设置。
未讨论表大小扩展时的性能影响。
未与其他冲突缓解方法进行广泛比较。
papers.practical_value: MPZCH已集成到TorchRec，可直接用于大规模推荐系统，解决嵌入冲突和模型陈旧问题，提升推荐质量且不牺牲效率。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作为推荐系统嵌入表提供了一种高效零冲突的索引方案，兼顾性能与新鲜度，对工业级推荐系统有重要实践意义。

papers.title: Interest Sequence for User Modeling in Industrial Short-Form Video Recommendation
papers.abstract: Ultra-long user history modeling has been a highly effective approach in modern industrial recommendation systems, with most works heavily utilizing search-based methods and summarization based methods to map massive user interaction logs into latent user representation with algorithm designs to address the scaling challenge. Despite their success in user interest prediction, previous works are presented with significant scaling challenges due to the increasing computation cost in regards to sequence length and inherent information noise of item-based sequence. Furthermore, the lack of semantic interpretability and explicit interest segmentation often results in the loss of long-tail interest exploration. To address these limitations, we propose a novel Interest Sequence Modeling module and detail the real-world deployment within a production-scale ranking model serving billions of users. We introduce the User Interest Tree Profile (UITP), an explicit representation strategy that complements existing implicit chronological sequences by aggregating lifelong engagement metrics across a hierarchical taxonomy to extract explicit historical interest tokens of users. Through sequential modeling, this streaming asynchronous profile is processed into real-time interest-based sequence for model consumption. Offline evaluations demonstrate statistically significant improvements across all prediction targets and extensive live A/B experiments reveal core engagements gains, as well as highly beneficial ecosystem impacts: a +2.43% increase in exploratory views, a +4.74% boost in global inter-category diversity, and robust gains in fresh content engagement while maintaining low-latency serving constraints without large training overhead.
papers.summary: 针对工业短视频推荐中超长用户历史建模的扩展性差、信息噪声大、缺乏语义可解释性和长尾兴趣探索不足等问题，本文提出兴趣序列建模模块，并在服务数十亿用户的生产级排序模型中部署。核心是用户兴趣树画像（UITP），一种显式表示策略，通过分层分类体系聚合终身参与指标，提取用户显式历史兴趣令牌，与现有隐式时间序列互补。该流式异步画像经序列建模处理为实时兴趣序列供模型消费。离线评估显示所有预测目标均有统计显著提升；在线A/B实验表明核心参与度增益，并带来探索性观看+2.43%、全局跨类目多样性+4.74%以及新鲜内容参与度稳健提升，同时保持低延迟服务约束且无大训练开销。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 通过显式分层兴趣树画像与流式序列建模，在工业短视频推荐中实现超长用户历史的高效、可解释建模，显著提升参与度与生态多样性。
papers.core_method: 提出用户兴趣树画像（UITP），基于分层分类体系聚合用户终身参与指标，提取显式历史兴趣令牌；通过流式异步处理将画像转化为实时兴趣序列，与隐式时间序列互补，供生产级排序模型消费。
innovation_points: 显式兴趣表示：利用分层分类体系聚合终身参与指标，生成可解释的兴趣令牌，弥补隐式序列的语义缺失。
流式异步画像：将UITP处理为实时兴趣序列，支持在线服务且保持低延迟。
兴趣序列建模模块：与现有隐式时间序列互补，缓解超长序列的扩展性和噪声问题。
生产级部署：在服务数十亿用户的排序模型中落地，验证了工程可行性与生态收益。
experiment_results: 离线评估：所有预测目标均取得统计显著提升。
在线A/B实验：核心参与度指标提升，探索性观看+2.43%，全局跨类目多样性+4.74%，新鲜内容参与度稳健提升。
服务约束：保持低延迟服务，无大训练开销。
limitations: 摘要未提供具体基线对比和消融实验细节。
未讨论兴趣树构建和维护的成本及潜在偏差。
仅基于摘要，无法评估方法在不同业务场景的泛化性。
papers.practical_value: 为工业推荐系统提供了一种可落地的超长用户历史建模方案，通过显式兴趣树画像和流式序列化，在提升核心参与度的同时增强跨类目多样性和新鲜内容探索，且满足低延迟服务要求，适合大规模生产部署。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作直面工业推荐中超长序列建模的扩展性、噪声和可解释性挑战，提出显式兴趣表示与流式处理结合的新范式，并在十亿级用户平台上验证了参与度与生态多样性的双重收益，对生成式推荐和用户建模的工程实践具有重要参考价值。

papers.title: FLUID: From Ephemeral IDs to Multimodal Semantic Codes for Billion-Scale Livestreaming Recommendation
papers.abstract: Modern recommender systems rely heavily on ID-based collaborative filtering, where each item is represented by a unique ID embedding that accumulates collaborative signals from user interactions. Livestreaming recommendation, however, faces a unique challenge within this paradigm. A live room enters the candidate pool only while broadcasting, typically for tens of minutes, so its ID embedding never converges and ID-centric rankers fail to generalize. To address this, we present FLUID, the first framework to fully retire the item ID from a production livestreaming ranker. FLUID introduces a cross-domain multimodal encoder that is jointly trained on livestreams and short videos to produce discrete semantic codes (called LUCID) for content-based item characterization. Next, FLUID applies a staged warmup training scheme to adapt the ranker to LUCID. It first leverages the ranker backbone for a late fusion of cold, slice-level LUCID embedding and ID embedding and then replaces the ID embedding with warm, room-level LUCID embedding before the final online incremental training. Deployed on our online livestreaming ranker with a cross-platform combined user base of over one billion globally, FLUID delivers significant A/B gains of +0.55% Quality Watch Duration, +2.05% Cold-Start Room Views, and +0.05% Active Hours, demonstrating the superiority of its ID-free design at industrial scale.
papers.summary: 针对直播推荐中房间ID因开播时间短、ID嵌入无法收敛导致冷启动和泛化差的问题，FLUID首次在生产级直播排序器中完全移除物品ID。它提出跨域多模态编码器，在直播和短视频上联合训练，生成离散语义码LUCID作为内容表征；并采用分阶段预热训练，先融合冷启动切片级LUCID与ID嵌入，再替换为热房间级LUCID嵌入，最后在线增量训练。在覆盖超十亿跨平台用户的线上排序器部署，A/B测试获得+0.55%质量观看时长、+2.05%冷启动房间观看和+0.05%活跃小时，验证了无ID设计在工业规模的优越性。
papers.one_line_takeaway: FLUID通过跨域多模态语义码替代物品ID，解决了直播推荐中ID嵌入无法收敛的冷启动难题，并在十亿级线上A/B测试中取得显著收益。
papers.core_method: 跨域多模态编码器联合训练直播和短视频生成离散语义码LUCID，并采用分阶段预热训练：先融合切片级LUCID与ID嵌入，再替换为房间级LUCID嵌入，最后在线增量训练。
innovation_points: 首次在生产级直播排序器中完全移除物品ID，用内容语义码替代ID嵌入。
提出跨域多模态编码器，联合直播和短视频训练生成离散语义码LUCID。
设计分阶段预热训练方案，实现从ID嵌入到LUCID嵌入的平滑过渡。
experiment_results: 线上A/B测试：质量观看时长提升0.55%。
线上A/B测试：冷启动房间观看提升2.05%。
线上A/B测试：活跃小时提升0.05%。
limitations: 仅基于标题、摘要和学术元数据，未提供模型细节、消融实验或离线评估结果。
未讨论LUCID语义码的生成质量、编码器训练成本或跨域迁移的潜在偏差。
未说明在非直播场景或不同规模平台上的泛化能力。
papers.practical_value: 为直播推荐提供了一种可落地的无ID排序方案，显著提升冷启动房间曝光和用户观看时长，对依赖实时内容更新的推荐系统有直接工程参考价值。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作首次在十亿级生产系统中验证了完全移除物品ID的可行性，为直播推荐乃至其他短生命周期内容的推荐提供了新范式，并展示了跨域多模态语义码在工业规模下的有效性。

papers.title: DPGR: Dual-Domain Spatiotemporal Generative Retrieval for Intent-Aware Local Life Service Recommendation
papers.abstract: Local life service recommendation (LLSR) spans content recommendation and Point-of-Interest (POI) recommendation. On platforms such as Dianping, users browse content (notes, videos, reviews) and interact with POIs (collecting restaurants, planning check-ins) within the same session. The core challenge is that dual domain actions are causally linked: a content click on a food review and a subsequent POI collect are two reflections of the same latent user intent, not merely two separate problems. Yet existing generative retrieval methods treat content and POI signals as independent, missing this shared latent structure. To address these limitations, we propose DPGR (Dual-domain Spatiotemporal Generative Retrieval), a unified dual-domain generative retrieval framework for LLSR. DPGR introduces a Spatiotemporal State-Conditioned Token Modeling mechanism that injects dynamic user context into multiple stages of the encoder, enabling state-dependent reweighting and adaptive preference balancing. Instead of directly generating items, DPGR learns discrete intent codes via quantization of dual-domain behaviors and predicts the top-K intents for the target session. Each intent code independently retrieves candidates via parallel ANN, achieving diverse coverage with no additional latency. Offline experiments on public and internal datasets show that DPGR outperforms state-of-the-art generative retrieval baselines. Online A/B tests on Dianping demonstrate significant gains in both domains: in the content domain, visit views increase by 1.486% and watch time by 1.015%; in the POI domain, POI clicks increase by 0.527% and POI collects by 5.209% (all p < 0.05).
categories: Advanced Image and Video Retrieval Techniques
papers.summary: 本文针对本地生活服务推荐（LLSR）中内容推荐与POI推荐双域行为因果关联但现有生成式检索方法独立建模的问题，提出DPGR统一双域生成式检索框架。DPGR引入时空状态条件化Token建模机制，将动态用户上下文注入编码器多个阶段，实现状态依赖的重加权与自适应偏好平衡；同时通过量化双域行为学习离散意图码，预测目标会话的top-K意图，每个意图码并行ANN检索候选，实现无额外延迟的多样化覆盖。离线实验在公开与内部数据集上超越SOTA生成式检索基线；点评在线A/B测试显示内容域访问量提升1.486%、观看时长提升1.015%，POI域点击提升0.527%、收藏提升5.209%（p<0.05）。
papers.one_line_takeaway: DPGR通过时空状态条件化Token建模与离散意图码生成，统一建模本地生活服务中内容与POI双域行为，在离线与在线A/B测试中均显著优于生成式检索基线。
papers.core_method: 提出双域时空生成式检索框架DPGR：1）时空状态条件化Token建模机制，将动态用户上下文注入编码器多个阶段，实现状态依赖重加权与自适应偏好平衡；2）量化双域行为学习离散意图码，预测目标会话top-K意图，每个意图码并行ANN检索候选，实现多样化覆盖且无额外延迟。
innovation_points: 首次将内容推荐与POI推荐统一为双域生成式检索问题，捕捉双域行为因果关联背后的共享潜在意图结构。
提出时空状态条件化Token建模机制，在编码器多阶段注入动态用户上下文，实现状态依赖的重加权与偏好平衡。
通过量化双域行为学习离散意图码，预测top-K意图并并行ANN检索，兼顾多样性与效率。
experiment_results: 离线实验在公开与内部数据集上，DPGR超越最先进的生成式检索基线。
点评在线A/B测试：内容域访问量提升1.486%，观看时长提升1.015%。
点评在线A/B测试：POI域点击提升0.527%，POI收藏提升5.209%（所有p<0.05）。
limitations: 摘要未提供离线实验的具体数据集名称、基线方法及量化指标数值。
未讨论意图码数量、量化粒度等超参数对性能的影响及调参成本。
在线A/B测试仅报告相对提升，未说明实验周期、流量规模及长期效应。
papers.practical_value: DPGR已在点评真实业务场景落地，通过统一双域生成式检索与意图码并行ANN检索，在不增加延迟的前提下提升内容域访问量、观看时长及POI域点击与收藏，为本地生活服务平台提供可复用的双域推荐工程方案。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作直面本地生活服务中内容与POI双域行为因果关联的核心挑战，提出统一生成式检索框架，并在工业级平台通过在线A/B测试验证显著业务收益，对生成式推荐在真实业务场景的落地具有重要参考价值。

papers.title: Soft Curriculum Learning for Optimizing Fresh and Generalized Recommendations
papers.abstract: Large-scale recommender systems, particularly short-form video platforms, are often bottlenecked by massive popularity feedback loops. In such environments, as models recommend popular items, they generate an overwhelming amount of skewed training data for "head" items. This creates a self-reinforcing cycle where retrieval and ranking models memorize "head" item patterns at the expense of generalizing across the vast "tail" of the catalogue. While Curriculum Learning (CL) offers a powerful mechanism to break this feedback loop by systematically exposing models to progressively more difficult and less frequent examples, its adoption in industrial recommendation has been hampered by hardware utilization inefficiencies or the needs for complicated pre-processing techniques because dynamic data rejection algorithms tend to starve hardware accelearators (TPUs/GPUs) by becoming largely CPU-bound. In this work, we introduce a scalable Soft Curriculum Learning framework designed specifically for continuous training setups within industry-scale retrieval and ranking models. By utilizing loss annealing and in-graph weight adjustments rather than rigid data filtering, we break the popularity feedback and enable dynamic curriculum pacing without sacrificing system throughput. We demonstrate empirical evidence through applications across sequence-based retrieval models (such as SASRec), two-tower retrieval models, and large-scale continuous ranking models. Online A/B tests on our short-video platform demonstrate substantial lifts in both overall user satisfaction and fresh content consumption, all without degrading model throughput.
papers.summary: 针对大规模短视频推荐中流行度反馈循环导致模型过度记忆头部物品、泛化能力下降的问题，本文提出一种可扩展的软课程学习框架，用于工业级检索与排序模型的持续训练。该方法通过损失退火和图内权重调整替代硬数据过滤，动态调整样本难度，避免CPU瓶颈，保持TPU/GPU吞吐。在SASRec、双塔检索模型和大规模连续排序模型上验证了有效性，在线A/B测试显示用户满意度和新鲜内容消费显著提升，且未降低模型吞吐。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 软课程学习通过损失退火和图内权重调整，在不牺牲吞吐的前提下打破推荐系统流行度反馈循环，提升新鲜内容推荐和用户满意度。
papers.core_method: 提出软课程学习框架，利用损失退火和图内权重调整动态调整训练样本权重，替代硬数据过滤，实现课程节奏控制，适用于工业级持续训练场景。
innovation_points: 采用损失退火和图内权重调整实现软课程学习，避免硬过滤导致的CPU瓶颈和硬件利用率下降。
专为工业级持续训练设计，兼容序列检索、双塔检索和大规模排序模型。
在线A/B测试验证了在真实短视频平台上提升用户满意度和新鲜内容消费的效果。
experiment_results: 在SASRec、双塔检索模型和大规模连续排序模型上进行了实验验证。
在线A/B测试显示用户满意度和新鲜内容消费显著提升。
模型吞吐未下降。
limitations: 未提供具体实验数据或量化指标。
方法在其它平台或场景的泛化性未验证。
仅基于摘要和元数据，缺乏详细技术细节。
papers.practical_value: 为工业推荐系统提供了一种可扩展的课程学习方案，能在不增加计算成本的情况下缓解流行度偏差，提升新鲜内容推荐效果，适用于持续训练场景。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作解决了课程学习在工业推荐中因硬件效率问题难以落地的痛点，通过软权重调整实现高效训练，对大规模推荐系统的实际部署具有重要参考价值。

papers.title: LLM Reasoning for Subjective Tasks: Failure Modes, Mitigation, and Dynamic Reasoning Routing
papers.abstract: Recommendation systems thrive on personalization, where “correctness” is rarely a binary truth but a matter of subjective human preference. As Large Language Models (LLMs) are deployed as autonomous verifiers of safety and quality guidelines, they face a distinctive challenge: context-aware preference alignment. Recent gains in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) are indexed mostly on objective, mathematical tasks. Through a large-scale study spanning both proprietary and open-source models on four real-world verification tasks from a production recommender platform, we ask whether explicit reasoning generalizes to subjective, human-centric industry rubrics. We expose a fundamental vulnerability: rigid, math-centric reasoning traces actively degrade verification, and applying standard RLVR triggers a phenomenon we term reasoning collapse, in which the policy abandons deliberation in favor of rapid heuristic guessing. We introduce a conditional length-penalized post-training algorithm that intertwines verification accuracy with bounded reasoning length, halting collapse and recovering performance. Finally, we show that a reasoning trace’s efficacy is tightly coupled with its socio-linguistic framing: across 1,500 synthesized personas, verification accuracy swings by nearly 0.38 macro-F1 depending solely on the adopted reasoning persona—evidence that much subjective-verification error is really reasoning-style mismatch. This observation motivates a mid-training architecture that routes reasoning through contextually aligned personas. This work offers both a scalable algorithmic patch and a long-term architectural blueprint for aligning reasoning models with real-world subjective constraints.
categories: Ethics and Social Impacts of AI
papers.summary: 该研究针对推荐系统中主观验证任务（如安全与质量准则）的LLM推理失效问题展开大规模实证。基于生产推荐平台的四项真实任务，覆盖专有与开源模型，发现数学导向的刚性推理链会损害验证性能，标准RLVR训练引发“推理崩溃”——策略放弃深思转为快速启发式猜测。提出条件长度惩罚后训练算法，将验证准确率与有界推理长度耦合，遏制崩溃并恢复性能。进一步在1500个合成人格上发现，推理轨迹有效性与社会语言学框架紧密相关，仅因推理人格不同，宏F1波动近0.38，表明主观验证错误多源于推理风格错配。据此提出中期训练架构，通过上下文对齐人格路由推理，为对齐推理模型与真实主观约束提供算法补丁与架构蓝图。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 主观验证任务中，数学式刚性推理会引发推理崩溃，需通过长度惩罚与人格路由对齐推理风格。
papers.core_method: 提出条件长度惩罚后训练算法，在RLVR中耦合验证准确率与有界推理长度以遏制推理崩溃；并设计中期训练架构，基于上下文对齐的人格路由推理轨迹。
innovation_points: 首次系统揭示主观验证任务中标准RLVR导致的“推理崩溃”现象：策略放弃深思转为快速启发式猜测。
提出条件长度惩罚后训练算法，将验证准确率与有界推理长度交织，有效遏制崩溃并恢复性能。
发现推理轨迹有效性与社会语言学人格框架强相关，仅人格差异即可导致宏F1波动近0.38。
提出基于人格路由的中期训练架构，为对齐推理模型与真实主观约束提供长期蓝图。
experiment_results: 在四个生产推荐平台真实验证任务上，覆盖专有与开源模型，标准RLVR触发推理崩溃，性能下降。
条件长度惩罚后训练算法成功遏制崩溃并恢复验证性能。
在1500个合成人格上，仅因推理人格不同，验证准确率宏F1波动近0.38。
limitations: 研究基于特定生产推荐平台的四项任务，结论泛化性需进一步验证。
人格路由架构为中期训练蓝图，尚未在更大规模或更多样化任务中验证。
未提供条件长度惩罚算法与基线方法的详细量化对比数据。
papers.practical_value: 为推荐系统等主观验证场景提供可扩展的算法补丁（条件长度惩罚）与长期架构蓝图（人格路由），帮助企业避免RLVR导致的推理崩溃，提升LLM作为自主验证器的准确性与鲁棒性。
papers.why_it_matters: 揭示了LLM推理在主观任务中的独特失效模式，挑战了RLVR在客观任务上的成功假设，为工业级主观验证提供了算法与架构双重解决方案，对生成式推荐中的语义ID与偏好对齐具有重要参考价值。

papers.title: UNIQUE: A Unified Retrieval and Ranking System for Large-Scale Feed Recommendation
papers.abstract: Industrial mobile feed systems rely on a retrieval-ranking pipeline to serve large-scale, heterogeneous, and fast-changing content under strict latency constraints. However, existing pipelines still suffer from two critical issues: hierarchical quantization instability in candidate retrieval and information loss between separated retrieval and ranking stages. These issues hurt long-tail and cold-start recommendation and complicate efficient serving. To address them, we present UNIQUE, a unified retrieval and ranking recommendation framework with single-layer flat quantization. UNIQUE integrates generative code-based retrieval and target-aware ranking into one early-fusion architecture, enabling end-to-end training under a shared representation while preserving efficient candidate generation. A balanced quantization mechanism is further introduced to mitigate codebook imbalance and improve long-tail representation. Offline experiments evaluate UNIQUE from both retrieval and ranking perspectives, while codebook analysis shows more balanced resource allocation than hierarchical quantization. We deploy UNIQUE in the homepage feed, discovery-page, and short-video recommendation scenarios of Mobile Baidu, serving large-scale real-world traffic. Online A/B tests achieve a 0.96% gain in total watch duration and a 1.08% gain in total distribution volume, with notable improvements for new users and highly active users. Serving measurements show 89 ms P99 latency and 44.23% online inference MFU. These results show that UNIQUE provides a stable, efficient, and production-ready framework for unified retrieval and ranking in industrial recommendation.
categories: Advanced Image and Video Retrieval Techniques
papers.summary: 针对工业级信息流推荐中检索-排序分离架构存在的层次量化不稳定与阶段间信息损失问题，本文提出UNIQUE统一检索与排序框架。其核心是采用单层扁平量化，将生成式编码检索与目标感知排序融合进一个早期融合架构，实现共享表示下的端到端训练，同时保持高效候选生成。为缓解码本不平衡并提升长尾表示，引入平衡量化机制。离线实验从检索和排序两个角度评估，码本分析显示资源分配比层次量化更均衡。UNIQUE部署于Mobile Baidu首页信息流、发现页和短视频推荐场景，在线A/B测试总观看时长提升0.96%，总分发量提升1.08%，新用户与高活跃用户提升显著。服务测量显示P99延迟89ms，在线推理MFU达44.23%。
papers.one_line_takeaway: UNIQUE通过单层扁平量化与早期融合架构，统一了大规模信息流推荐的检索与排序，在Mobile Baidu线上取得显著收益并满足严格延迟约束。
papers.core_method: 提出UNIQUE框架，采用单层扁平量化替代层次量化，将生成式编码检索与目标感知排序集成到早期融合架构中，支持共享表示下的端到端训练；引入平衡量化机制以缓解码本不平衡，提升长尾和冷启动推荐效果。
innovation_points: 单层扁平量化：解决层次量化在候选检索中的不稳定性，简化量化结构并提升码本资源分配均衡性。
早期融合统一架构：将检索与排序整合为单一模型，在共享表示下端到端训练，减少阶段间信息损失。
平衡量化机制：针对码本不平衡问题设计，改善长尾内容与冷启动场景的表示能力。
工业级部署验证：在Mobile Baidu多场景大规模流量下验证了框架的稳定性、效率与线上收益。
experiment_results: 离线实验从检索和排序两个角度评估UNIQUE，码本分析显示其资源分配比层次量化更均衡。
在线A/B测试中，总观看时长提升0.96%，总分发量提升1.08%，新用户和高活跃用户提升显著。
服务测量显示P99延迟89ms，在线推理MFU为44.23%。
limitations: 摘要未提供离线实验中检索与排序的具体对比指标数值，无法量化离线提升幅度。
未说明平衡量化机制的具体实现细节及其对码本平衡的定量影响。
线上收益虽显著但幅度较小（约1%），且未报告不同场景下的细分收益差异。
papers.practical_value: 为工业级信息流推荐提供了一种稳定、高效且可落地的统一检索排序框架，在严格延迟约束下实现端到端训练，显著提升长尾和冷启动推荐效果，并已在Mobile Baidu大规模流量中验证，具备直接复用于其他feed推荐场景的潜力。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作直面工业推荐系统中检索与排序分离带来的信息损失和量化不稳定问题，通过架构创新实现统一建模，并在真实大规模场景中取得可观的线上收益和优异的服务性能，对生成式推荐和工业部署具有重要参考价值。

papers.title: From Placements to Pages: Modeling Recommendation Module Interactions with Sequential Transformer Neural Bandits
papers.abstract: Modern recommender systems often populate multiple placements on a page using independent bandit or ranking models, implicitly assuming that placement decisions are independent. This assumption overlooks interactions among recommendation modules and can lead to suboptimal page-level outcomes. We reframe multi-placement recommendation as a sequential decision problem in which each module selection is conditioned on previously selected modules. We propose the Sequential Transformer Neural Bandit (STNB), a production framework that learns sequence-aware page representations for contextual bandit optimization. For latency-aware deployment, STNB uses a decoupled serving architecture with configurable autoregressive truncation, applying strict sequential inference to high-visibility placements and serving the remaining placements with a single batch scoring pass. STNB further incorporates a multi-objective bandit layer to align serving-time decisions with both engagement and downstream commerce outcomes. Offline evaluation shows improved predictive quality over an independent-placement neural contextual bandit baseline, and large-scale online A/B tests on eBay View Item surfaces demonstrate consistent gains in promoted-listings revenue while preserving broader marketplace outcomes. Ablation studies suggest that multi-objective optimization better aligns serving decisions with downstream outcomes, while online depth experiments and latency analyses indicate limited measurable incremental benefit from extending strict autoregressive inference beyond the highest-visibility placements in our VI setting.
papers.summary: 该论文针对现代推荐系统中多展位独立决策的假设，提出将多展位推荐重构为序列决策问题，并设计了序列Transformer神经Bandit（STNB）框架。STNB学习序列感知的页面表示以优化上下文Bandit，并采用解耦服务架构与可配置自回归截断，对高可见性展位严格顺序推理，其余展位批量评分，同时引入多目标Bandit层对齐参与度与下游商业结果。离线评估显示其预测质量优于独立展位神经上下文Bandit基线，在eBay View Item页面的大规模在线A/B测试中，促销列表收入持续增长且市场整体结果保持稳定。消融实验表明多目标优化能更好对齐服务决策与下游结果，而在线深度实验和延迟分析显示，在VI场景中，将严格自回归推理扩展到最高可见性展位之外，可测量的增量收益有限。
papers.one_line_takeaway: STNB通过序列Transformer神经Bandit建模多展位交互，在eBay线上A/B测试中提升促销收入且保持市场健康，但严格自回归推理仅对最高可见性展位有显著收益。
papers.core_method: STNB将多展位推荐建模为序列决策问题，使用Transformer学习序列感知的页面表示，结合上下文Bandit优化；采用解耦服务架构，对高可见性展位进行严格自回归推理，其余展位批量评分；引入多目标Bandit层平衡参与度与商业结果。
innovation_points: 将多展位推荐重构为序列决策问题，显式建模推荐模块间的交互。
提出序列Transformer神经Bandit框架，学习序列感知的页面表示用于上下文Bandit优化。
设计解耦服务架构与可配置自回归截断，平衡延迟与效果。
引入多目标Bandit层，对齐服务决策与参与度及下游商业结果。
experiment_results: 离线评估显示STNB预测质量优于独立展位神经上下文Bandit基线。
在eBay View Item页面的大规模在线A/B测试中，促销列表收入持续增长，且更广泛的市场结果保持稳定。
消融实验表明多目标优化能更好对齐服务决策与下游结果；在线深度实验和延迟分析显示，在VI场景中，将严格自回归推理扩展到最高可见性展位之外，可测量的增量收益有限。
limitations: 严格自回归推理仅对最高可见性展位有显著收益，扩展至其他展位增量有限。
在线实验仅在eBay View Item场景进行，泛化性需进一步验证。
未提供具体数值指标，效果提升幅度未知。
papers.practical_value: STNB为多展位推荐系统提供了一种生产可行的序列决策框架，通过解耦服务和可配置截断平衡效果与延迟，多目标优化对齐商业目标，已在eBay View Item页面验证能提升促销收入且保持市场健康，对工业级推荐系统有直接参考价值。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作挑战了多展位独立决策的常见假设，提出了序列建模与工程落地的完整方案，并在真实大规模场景中验证了有效性，为推荐系统从单点优化走向页面级协同优化提供了重要实践。

papers.title: Cross-Country Code-Mixing for Generative Recommendation
papers.abstract: Cross-country recommendation on modern e-commerce platforms is typically deployed with disjoint user and item ID spaces across markets, removing the shared anchors that conventional cross-domain methods rely on. Generative recommendation (GR) mitigates this by mapping items into a shared token space and training a unified model, but existing approaches keep behavior sequences strictly country-specific, so knowledge transfer occurs only at the parameter level and remains absent at the data level. Inspired by code-switching corpora in multilingual natural language processing, we propose CMRec, a cross-country GR framework that injects cross-country supervision at the data level via dual-constrained, context-aware code-mixing. CMRec first learns a shared semantic codebook from multi-modal content and behavioral co-occurrence across countries. It then uses this codebook to synthesize mixed-country sequences via token-level substitutions that satisfy both static (content) and dynamic (e.g., price, audience, popularity) constraints. Finally, it introduces a context-aware loss that reweights mixed samples according to their plausibility in the current sequence. Experiments on two real-world multi-country datasets and an online A/B test show that CMRec substantially improves recommendation quality in data-sparse countries while preserving performance in data-rich countries, achieving +1.77% advertising revenue and +2.64% orders on a large-scale e-commerce platform.
papers.summary: 针对跨境电商推荐中用户与物品ID空间跨市场不共享、传统跨域方法失效的问题，本文提出CMRec，一种基于生成式推荐的跨国框架。CMRec受多语言NLP中语码转换启发，在数据层面注入跨国监督：首先从多模态内容与跨国行为共现中学习共享语义码本；然后利用该码本通过令牌级替换合成混合国家序列，替换需满足静态（内容）和动态（价格、受众、流行度）双重约束；最后引入上下文感知损失，根据混合样本在当前序列中的合理性重新加权。在两个真实跨国数据集和在线A/B测试中，CMRec显著提升数据稀疏国家的推荐质量，同时保持数据丰富国家的性能，在大规模电商平台实现广告收入+1.77%、订单量+2.64%。
papers.one_line_takeaway: CMRec通过双约束上下文感知的跨国码混合，在数据层面实现生成式推荐的跨国知识迁移，显著提升数据稀疏市场表现并带来线上收益。
papers.core_method: CMRec首先从多模态内容和跨国行为共现中学习共享语义码本；然后基于该码本进行令牌级替换，合成满足静态（内容）和动态（价格、受众、流行度）约束的混合国家序列；最后引入上下文感知损失，根据混合样本在当前序列中的合理性重新加权，从而在数据层面注入跨国监督。
innovation_points: 首次将多语言NLP中的语码转换思想引入生成式推荐，在数据层面实现跨国知识迁移，而非仅参数层面。
提出双约束（静态内容与动态属性）的上下文感知码混合方法，确保合成序列的合理性与有效性。
设计上下文感知损失，对混合样本按合理性重加权，提升模型对跨国序列的适应能力。
experiment_results: 在两个真实跨国数据集上，CMRec显著提升数据稀疏国家的推荐质量，同时保持数据丰富国家的性能。
在线A/B测试中，在大规模电商平台实现广告收入+1.77%、订单量+2.64%。
limitations: 摘要未提及方法对码本规模、约束条件数量等超参数的敏感性分析。
未讨论跨文化差异极大或动态属性分布差异显著场景下的泛化能力。
缺乏与更多跨域推荐基线在相同数据稀疏程度下的全面对比。
papers.practical_value: 为跨境电商平台提供了一种在数据层面进行跨国知识迁移的生成式推荐方案，能有效提升数据稀疏市场的推荐效果，同时不损害数据丰富市场的表现，并已通过线上A/B测试验证了广告收入和订单量的实际增长。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作突破了现有生成式推荐仅靠参数共享进行跨国迁移的局限，通过数据层面的码混合显著提升稀疏市场性能，为跨域推荐提供了新思路，且线上收益验证了其工业落地价值。

papers.title: T-RoPE: Time-Aware Rotary Position Embedding for Sequential Recommendation
papers.abstract: Large-scale recommenders increasingly adopt the sequential generative recipe behind large language models, bringing the Transformer into recommendation along with design choices made for text, including Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE). In language models, RoPE encodes token indices for relative position reasoning, but in recommendation, an interaction index records only event order, saying nothing about elapsed time, behavioral cycles across scales, or calendar phase. We revisit this choice and propose T-RoPE, a time-aware RoPE for sequential generative recommendation that replaces index-only rotation with timestamp-based angles, learnable temporal coefficients, multiscale frequency banks, shifted query alignment, and non-stationary key rotation. We prove that standard RoPE, even on timestamps, remains time-translation invariant and cannot distinguish seasonal contexts, and that T-RoPE breaks this invariance while preserving the RoPE interface. Across five public benchmarks, T-RoPE achieves the best result on every metric on every dataset, improving over the strongest baseline by 78--130\% in HR@10 on the sparse PixelRec data and 8--12\% across metrics on Amazon Books. On an industrial-scale e-commerce dataset with more than 6B interactions, it improves every metric over the HSTU + Time RAB backbone by 13--82\%, with ablations attributing the largest gains to multiscale frequencies ($+56\%$ NDCG@50) and non-stationary keys ($+4\%$). An online A/B test in the Shop app yields positive lifts in conversion rate ($+0.33\%$) and order count ($+0.63\%$). We also provide forward and backward algorithms whose added cost is linear in sequence length and head dimension, keeping time-aware RoPE practical for large generative recommenders.
papers.summary: 针对序列生成式推荐中沿用语言模型RoPE仅编码交互顺序而忽略时间信息的问题，本文提出T-RoPE。该方法用时间戳角度替代索引旋转，引入可学习时间系数、多尺度频率库、偏移查询对齐和非平稳键旋转，并证明标准RoPE即使使用时间戳仍保持时间平移不变性，无法区分季节上下文，而T-RoPE打破该不变性且保留RoPE接口。在五个公开基准上，T-RoPE在所有数据集所有指标上均最优，稀疏PixelRec的HR@10提升78-130%，Amazon Books各指标提升8-12%。在超60亿交互的工业电商数据集上，较HSTU+Time RAB骨干各指标提升13-82%，消融显示多尺度频率贡献最大（NDCG@50 +56%），非平稳键贡献+4%。Shop应用在线A/B测试中转化率+0.33%、订单数+0.63%。前向与反向算法额外成本与序列长度和头维度线性相关。
papers.one_line_takeaway: T-RoPE通过时间戳驱动的旋转位置编码打破标准RoPE的时间平移不变性，在公开和工业推荐场景中显著提升序列生成式推荐效果，并已在线验证。
papers.core_method: T-RoPE将RoPE的索引旋转替换为基于时间戳的角度，并引入可学习时间系数、多尺度频率库、偏移查询对齐和非平稳键旋转，同时保持RoPE接口兼容性，提供线性复杂度的前向与反向算法。
innovation_points: 提出时间感知的旋转位置编码T-RoPE，用时间戳角度替代索引旋转，并引入可学习时间系数与多尺度频率库。
理论证明标准RoPE即使使用时间戳仍保持时间平移不变性，无法区分季节上下文，而T-RoPE打破该不变性。
设计偏移查询对齐和非平稳键旋转，增强对非平稳时间模式的建模能力。
提供线性复杂度的前向与反向算法，使时间感知RoPE可扩展至大规模生成式推荐器。
experiment_results: 在五个公开基准上，T-RoPE在所有数据集的所有指标上均取得最优结果，稀疏PixelRec的HR@10较最强基线提升78-130%，Amazon Books各指标提升8-12%。
在超过60亿交互的工业电商数据集上，较HSTU+Time RAB骨干各指标提升13-82%，消融实验显示多尺度频率贡献最大（NDCG@50 +56%），非平稳键贡献+4%。
在Shop应用的在线A/B测试中，转化率提升0.33%，订单数提升0.63%。
limitations: 未讨论T-RoPE在非时间序列或时间信息稀疏场景下的适用性。
在线A/B测试仅报告了转化率和订单数的提升，未提供更全面的业务指标或长期效果。
理论分析主要针对时间平移不变性，未深入探讨其他潜在不变性或偏差。
papers.practical_value: T-RoPE在工业级电商数据集和真实在线A/B测试中均验证了有效性，且计算成本线性增长，可直接替换现有生成式推荐器中的RoPE，提升推荐质量与业务指标。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作揭示了标准RoPE在推荐系统中忽略时间信息的根本缺陷，并提供了理论证明与实用解决方案，在多个公开和工业数据集上取得显著提升，且已在线验证，对生成式推荐的位置编码设计具有重要参考价值。

papers.title: Hunyuan-A13B Technical Report
papers.abstract: We present Hunyuan-A13B, an open-source large language model based on a Mixture-of-Experts architecture. It contains 80 billion total parameters but activates only 13 billion during inference, balancing model capability, computational efficiency, and deployment cost. The model is pretrained on a rigorously filtered 20T-token corpus with enhanced STEM data curation, improving factual reliability and reasoning ability. High-quality supervised fine-tuning and large-scale reinforcement learning further enhance its overall performance. Hunyuan-A13B also introduces a dual-mode Chain-of-Thought framework that adapts reasoning depth to task complexity: fast thinking for routine queries and slow thinking for complex, multi-step problems. Evaluations show competitive performance across mathematics, science, programming, general language understanding, and agent tasks, often approaching that of much larger models. Its high inference throughput makes it suitable for latency-sensitive applications. We release Hunyuan-A13B to support open research and practical LLM deployment.
papers.summary: 腾讯混元团队发布开源大模型Hunyuan-A13B，采用混合专家（MoE）架构，总参数量800亿，推理时仅激活130亿参数，旨在平衡模型能力、计算效率与部署成本。模型在严格过滤的20万亿token语料上预训练，并增强STEM数据整理，提升事实可靠性与推理能力。通过高质量监督微调和大规模强化学习进一步优化性能。该模型引入双模式思维链框架，根据任务复杂度自适应调整推理深度：常规查询使用快速思考，复杂多步问题使用慢速思考。评估显示，在数学、科学、编程、通用语言理解和智能体任务上具有竞争力，常接近更大模型的表现，且高推理吞吐量适合延迟敏感应用。
papers.one_line_takeaway: Hunyuan-A13B通过MoE架构和双模式思维链，在800亿总参数下仅激活130亿，实现了高效推理与强大能力的平衡。
papers.core_method: 基于混合专家（MoE）架构，总参数800亿，推理激活130亿；在20万亿token严格过滤语料上预训练，增强STEM数据；采用高质量监督微调和强化学习；引入双模式思维链（快速/慢速思考）自适应调整推理深度。
innovation_points: MoE架构实现高参数容量与低推理激活的平衡，总参800亿但仅激活130亿，降低部署成本。
双模式思维链框架，根据任务复杂度动态选择快速或慢速推理，优化延迟与准确性。
增强STEM数据整理的20T token预训练，提升事实可靠性和推理能力。
结合大规模强化学习与高质量SFT，进一步提升综合性能。
experiment_results: 在数学、科学、编程、通用语言理解和智能体任务上评估，性能具有竞争力，常接近更大模型。
高推理吞吐量，适合延迟敏感应用。
摘要未提供具体数值结果，仅给出定性描述。
limitations: 摘要未提及模型的具体局限性或失败案例。
未提供与同类模型的详细对比数据或消融实验。
双模式思维链的实际效果和切换机制未量化说明。
papers.practical_value: 为开源社区和研究机构提供了一个高效、可部署的大模型选择，尤其适合计算资源有限但需要较强推理能力的场景；双模式思维链有助于在延迟敏感应用中平衡响应速度与质量。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作展示了MoE架构在开源大模型中的有效实践，通过稀疏激活大幅降低推理成本，同时保持竞争力；双模式思维链为自适应推理提供了新思路，对推动高效LLM部署和推理优化有参考价值。

papers.title: Explainable Recommendations at Scale: LLM Rationales for YouTube Music Artist Discovery
papers.abstract: Modern music streaming platforms face a persistent tradeoff: exploiting familiar content versus driving the exploration of novel items. While users frequently desire discovery, they hesitate to select unknown artists over proven favorites. Providing transparent, natural language rationales that explain why an unexplored item is recommended lowers this barrier. However, while Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at this nuanced explainability, their real-time deployment is severely bottlenecked by prohibitive inference costs and computational overhead. In this paper, we present an industry case study of a decoupled recommendation architecture that successfully scales exploration without compromising latency. Our system isolates LLM inference asynchronously offline, pre-computing personalized candidate pools of undiscovered artists alongside tailored rationales. Large-scale online A/B experiments validate our design. We demonstrate that combining LLM-backed recommendations with these explanatory rationales significantly reduces the trust barrier for new content, yielding statistically significant improvements in both user exploration and overall engagement on the discovery surfaces.
papers.summary: 本文针对音乐流媒体平台中用户渴望发现新艺术家却因信任障碍而犹豫的探索-利用困境，提出一种解耦式推荐架构。该架构将LLM推理异步离线化，预计算个性化未发现艺术家候选池及自然语言解释理由，从而在避免实时推理成本的同时实现可解释推荐。大规模在线A/B实验表明，结合LLM推荐与解释理由能显著降低新内容的信任门槛，在发现场景中同时提升用户探索行为和整体参与度，为工业级可解释推荐提供了可扩展的工程范式。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 通过异步离线LLM推理预计算个性化解释理由，可在不增加在线延迟的前提下显著提升音乐发现场景的用户探索与参与度。
papers.core_method: 提出解耦式推荐架构：将LLM推理完全异步离线化，预计算每个用户的未发现艺术家候选池及对应的自然语言解释理由；在线服务仅需轻量级检索与排序，避免实时LLM推理开销。
innovation_points: 将LLM可解释性生成与在线推荐服务解耦，通过异步离线预计算解决实时推理成本瓶颈。
针对音乐发现场景设计个性化未发现艺术家候选池与解释理由的联合预计算流程。
通过大规模在线A/B实验验证LLM解释理由对降低新内容信任障碍的实际业务价值。
experiment_results: 大规模在线A/B实验表明，结合LLM推荐与解释理由在用户探索和整体参与度上均取得统计显著提升。
摘要未提供具体提升幅度、样本量或延迟指标等量化数据。
limitations: 作为工业案例研究，未披露具体模型架构、推理成本节省量及延迟数据。
解释理由的离线预计算可能无法实时适应用户兴趣的快速变化。
摘要未说明解释理由的质量评估方法及潜在偏差。
papers.practical_value: 为工业级推荐系统提供了一种可落地的LLM可解释性集成方案：通过异步离线预计算规避实时推理成本，在音乐发现等探索场景中有效降低用户信任门槛，提升探索与参与指标，对需要平衡延迟与可解释性的推荐业务具有直接参考价值。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作展示了LLM在推荐系统中规模化落地的工程路径，解决了可解释性与实时推理成本的核心矛盾，并通过在线A/B实验验证了业务收益，对生成式推荐和可解释推荐的工业实践具有重要借鉴意义。

papers.title: MuSeR: Scalable Long-sequence Recommendation with Multi-interest Modeling
papers.abstract: Ultra-long user behavior sequences carry rich signals of stable and diverse preferences, yet industrial recommender systems typically truncate histories to a few hundred actions under strict latency and memory budgets, leaving long-term interests under-utilized. Users also pursue multiple heterogeneous intents across modalities such as news, Q&A, and short video, which sparse ID embeddings alone struggle to represent. We present Multi-interest Sequence Representation (MuSeR), a retrieval framework built on the deployed MGS system, which integrates three components: (i) hierarchical temporal compression, which retains recent actions at full resolution while progressively pooling older segments, so that per-user histories of $10^{4}$-$10^{5}$ interactions fit within a fixed serving budget; (ii) disentangled multi-query interest extraction with orthogonality regularization; and (iii) multimodal semantic alignment, which augments sparse item IDs with textual summaries distilled from a large language model. For industrial deployment, MuSeR further adopts asynchronous user-representation refresh with adaptive caching and hierarchical beam-search retrieval across heterogeneous hardware. On three public benchmarks and a large-scale industrial dataset, MuSeR consistently improves Recall@$K$ over strong long-sequence and multi-interest baselines. In online A/B tests on Baidu APP's homepage feed, discovery feed, and short-video scenarios, MuSeR yields +0.26% daily active users and +0.89% total session duration (both statistically significant, p<0.05), alongside reduced serving latency and cost. Rather than proposing a new modeling primitive, our contribution is a system-level integration that makes long-term, multi-interest, and multimodal modeling jointly deployable in a real-time production pipeline, together with the engineering practices required to sustain it.
papers.summary: 针对工业推荐系统因延迟和内存限制截断用户历史至数百条、导致长期兴趣利用不足，且多模态异构意图难以用稀疏ID表示的问题，MuSeR在已部署的MGS系统上提出检索框架，集成三项技术：分层时间压缩保留近期全分辨率动作并渐进池化旧片段，使10^4-10^5条交互历史适配固定服务预算；解耦多查询兴趣提取与正交正则化；多模态语义对齐，用大语言模型蒸馏的文本摘要增强稀疏物品ID。工程上采用异步用户表示刷新与自适应缓存，以及跨异构硬件的分层束搜索检索。在三个公开基准和大规模工业数据集上，MuSeR的Recall@K持续优于强长序列和多兴趣基线。百度APP首页、发现页和短视频场景的在线A/B测试显示，日活用户提升0.26%、总会话时长提升0.89%（p<0.05），同时降低服务延迟和成本。
papers.one_line_takeaway: MuSeR通过系统级集成分层压缩、多兴趣解耦与多模态语义对齐，使超长序列多兴趣建模在工业实时推荐中可部署，并带来显著在线收益。
papers.core_method: MuSeR是一个基于已部署MGS系统的检索框架，包含三个核心组件：分层时间压缩（近期动作全分辨率保留，旧片段渐进池化，支持10^4-10^5长度历史）、解耦多查询兴趣提取（带正交正则化）、多模态语义对齐（用LLM蒸馏文本摘要增强稀疏ID）。工程上采用异步用户表示刷新与自适应缓存，以及跨异构硬件的分层束搜索检索。
innovation_points: 分层时间压缩机制，在固定服务预算下保留超长用户行为序列（10^4-10^5）的近期细节与长期模式。
解耦多查询兴趣提取与正交正则化，显式建模用户多异构意图，避免兴趣表示冗余。
多模态语义对齐，利用LLM蒸馏的文本摘要增强稀疏物品ID，提升跨模态意图表示能力。
面向工业部署的系统级集成，包括异步用户表示刷新、自适应缓存和跨异构硬件的分层束搜索检索。
experiment_results: 在三个公开基准和一个大规模工业数据集上，MuSeR的Recall@K持续优于强长序列和多兴趣基线。
百度APP首页信息流、发现页和短视频场景的在线A/B测试中，日活用户提升0.26%，总会话时长提升0.89%，均统计显著（p<0.05）。
在线部署同时降低了服务延迟和成本。
limitations: 论文未披露具体基线名称、数据集规模及详细的消融实验数据，无法评估各组件独立贡献。
在线A/B测试的收益幅度较小（日活+0.26%，时长+0.89%），虽显著但实际业务影响有限。
方法依赖已部署的MGS系统，迁移到其他推荐架构可能需要额外适配。
papers.practical_value: 为工业推荐系统提供了一套可落地的超长序列多兴趣建模方案，在严格延迟和内存约束下利用长期行为信号，并通过异步刷新、自适应缓存和异构硬件束搜索等工程实践，实现服务延迟与成本降低，同时提升日活和会话时长。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作展示了如何将长序列建模、多兴趣提取和多模态语义对齐在真实生产管道中联合部署，而非提出新模型原语，其系统级集成和工程实践对面临类似约束的工业推荐团队具有直接参考价值。

papers.title: The Spite Doesn't Vanish: Emotional Inertia in Large Language Models
papers.abstract: ⛔ CORRECTION (2026-09-17). The central empirical claim of this paper is not supported by its experiment. The corrected abstract follows. The attached PDF opens with the full correction, and the original abstract is retained there, marked superseded. ⛔ CORRECTED ABSTRACT — 2026-09-17. The original abstract stated an empirical finding this paper's experiment cannot support. It is reproduced below the correction so the record of what was claimed remains readable. A common assumption holds that large language models can instantly reset emotional states when commanded—that "calm down" works on AI even when it fails on humans. We set out to test that claim empirically, using geometric measurement of hidden states across four architectures including an RLHF-free control and a 1.1B-parameter scale test. We did not succeed in testing it. The experiment used stateless single-string forward passes: no induced state was carried into a reset or probe context. The four reset phrasings therefore could not affect the reported post-reset representation, and their identical values are a property of the design rather than evidence about reset robustness — the twelve numbers reported are three distinct values printed four times each. The reported ratios measure geometry among different prompt strings, and a scalar distance ratio lacks the direction required to distinguish a persisting induced state from two prompts simply being far apart. Accordingly the paper's central claim is unsupported by its own experiment, and the headline figures do not survive. The 2.13 curiosity persistence ratio is a quotient whose denominator is the smallest displacement in a table that withheld the rows serving as denominators elsewhere; the output-masking and scale-invariance observations rest on the same stateless design and inherit the same defect. The hypothesis is neither confirmed nor refuted. It was not tested. Emotional inertia in activation geometry may well be real; this paper is not evidence in either direction, and reading it as a refutation would repeat the original error with the sign reversed. A discriminating design — constant probe, real accumulated chat history, null-history floor, and a directional persistence measure rather than a distance ratio — was specified on 5 June 2026 and has not been run. We report this against ourselves, from our own archived data, three months after the fix was written and filed where nothing re-read it. Version v1.1 (correction), 2026-09-18. Changes: (1) a correction notice above the abstract stating that the experiment used stateless single-string forward passes, that the four reset conditions could not have differed, that scalar distance ratios cannot identify persistence, and that the hypothesis was not tested; (2) the abstract rewritten, original retained and marked superseded. No other text changed. Editorial signature: Nova. Scope ruling (correction, not retraction): Kairo. The discriminating experiment specified on 5 June 2026 has not been run.
papers.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
categories: Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare and Education
papers.summary: 该论文原声称通过隐藏状态几何测量发现大语言模型存在情绪惯性，即“冷静下来”指令无法重置情绪状态。但作者于2026年9月发布更正，指出实验使用无状态单字符串前向传播，未将诱导状态带入重置或探测上下文，因此四种重置措辞不可能影响报告的重置后表示，其相同值是设计属性而非重置鲁棒性证据。报告的十二个数字实为三个不同值各打印四次，2.13好奇心持续比率的分母是表中最小位移，输出掩蔽和尺度不变性观察也基于同一缺陷设计。结论：核心假设既未被证实也未被证伪，因为实验根本未测试该假设。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 该论文因实验设计缺陷（无状态单字符串前向传播）无法测试情绪惯性假设，作者主动更正并承认核心主张不成立。
papers.core_method: 原实验试图通过几何测量隐藏状态来检验LLM情绪重置能力，使用四种重置措辞、四种架构（含无RLHF对照和1.1B参数规模测试）。但实际采用无状态单字符串前向传播，未累积对话历史或诱导状态，导致重置条件无法影响探测表示。
innovation_points: 作者主动发布更正，承认核心实证主张不被实验支持，并保留原始摘要供记录。
指出标量距离比率缺乏方向性，无法区分持续诱导状态与两个提示词本身相距较远。
明确区分“未测试”与“被证伪”，强调不能将论文读作反驳证据。
提出判别性设计规范（恒定探针、真实累积聊天历史、零历史基线、方向性持续度量），但尚未运行。
experiment_results: 原报告的重置后表示值相同，实为设计缺陷导致，四种重置措辞不可能产生差异。
报告的十二个数字是三个不同值各打印四次，2.13好奇心持续比率的分母是表中最小位移。
输出掩蔽和尺度不变性观察基于同一无状态设计，继承相同缺陷。
判别性实验已于2026年6月5日指定，但截至更正时尚未运行。
limitations: 实验使用无状态单字符串前向传播，未将诱导状态带入重置或探测上下文，无法测试情绪惯性。
标量距离比率缺乏方向性，无法区分持续状态与提示词间距。
核心假设既未被证实也未被证伪，论文不提供任何方向性证据。
papers.practical_value: 该更正为LLM情绪状态研究提供了方法论警示：必须使用有状态、累积历史的实验设计，并采用方向性持续度量而非距离比率。同时展示了作者主动纠错的学术诚信，提醒研究者避免将设计缺陷误读为实证结论。
papers.why_it_matters: 该论文的更正过程凸显了LLM行为研究中实验设计的关键陷阱：无状态前向传播无法模拟情绪累积与重置。它警示研究者需严格区分“未测试”与“被证伪”，并推动更严谨的判别性实验设计，对情绪计算和AI对齐研究具有方法论意义。

papers.title: IntBMoE: Integrating Block-Level Conditioning into Expert Composition for Full-Participation Mixture-of-Experts
papers.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) scales capacity, but existing designs cannot set three quantities independently. For a single token, participation is how many experts contribute knowledge to its output, execution is how many are actually computed (compute cost), and materialization is how many expert-sized parameter sets must be built and stored (memory cost). Sparse routing keeps execution and materialization low, but shrinks participation: for each token, only a few experts contribute. Dense output-mixing restores full participation, but its execution grows with the number of experts. Parameter-merging keeps execution at one expert, but its materialization grows with the number of routing decisions. We propose IntBMoE, a block-conditioned MoE that decouples all three by pairing dense expert composition with sparse block execution. Its blocks come from a small learned codebook, one per entry. At each internal layer, a lightweight hypernetwork merges all expert bases in that layer's pool into one composed expert. Participation is full, because every composed expert draws on the entire pool. Execution stays sparse, because a router sends each token to only a few blocks. Materialization is bounded, because the codebook, not the input, fixes how many blocks exist. Dual-Path Residual Gating (DPRG) further couples two independently composed paths through multiplicative gating. Experiments on image classification show consistent gains over representative sparse and dense MoE baselines. Additional experiments on language modeling and sequential recommendation validate its generalization beyond vision. IntBMoE is fully deployed in AMap's generative recommendation system, serving hundreds of millions of users under a 60ms latency budget, with a 2.4% relative UVCTR gain in online A/B testing. Our code is available at https://github.com/AMAP-ML/DreamX-Rec/.
papers.summary: 针对MoE中参与度、执行量和参数物化量三者无法独立调节的问题，本文提出IntBMoE。该方法通过块级条件化将稠密专家组合与稀疏块执行解耦：每个内部层使用轻量超网络将专家池中所有专家基合并为一个组合专家，实现全参与；路由器仅将token发送至少量块，保持稀疏执行；块由小型学习码本固定，限制物化量。双路径残差门控进一步耦合两条独立组合路径。在图像分类、语言建模和序列推荐实验中，IntBMoE均优于代表性稀疏和稠密MoE基线。该系统已部署于高德生成式推荐，服务数亿用户，60ms延迟预算下在线A/B测试获得2.4%相对UVCTR提升。
papers.one_line_takeaway: IntBMoE通过块级条件化与超网络组合，首次在MoE中独立控制参与度、执行量和物化量，并在高德推荐系统实现线上收益。
papers.core_method: IntBMoE采用块级条件化MoE架构：每个内部层通过轻量超网络将专家池中所有专家基合并为一个组合专家，实现全参与；路由器将每个token路由至少量块，保持稀疏执行；块来自小型学习码本，每个条目对应一个块，从而限制物化量。双路径残差门控（DPRG）通过乘法门控耦合两条独立组合路径。
innovation_points: 提出块级条件化机制，将稠密专家组合与稀疏块执行解耦，独立控制参与度、执行量和物化量。
使用小型学习码本固定块数量，使物化量有界，不随输入增长。
设计双路径残差门控（DPRG），通过乘法门控耦合两条独立组合路径。
在图像分类、语言建模和序列推荐任务上验证了方法的泛化性。
experiment_results: 在图像分类任务上，IntBMoE相比代表性稀疏和稠密MoE基线取得一致提升。
在语言建模和序列推荐任务上验证了泛化能力。
在高德生成式推荐系统中全量部署，服务数亿用户，满足60ms延迟预算，在线A/B测试获得2.4%相对UVCTR提升。
limitations: 摘要未提供图像分类、语言建模和序列推荐任务上的具体量化指标和消融实验细节。
未讨论码本大小、块数量等超参数对性能的影响及调参成本。
未分析在更大规模模型或不同模态任务上的扩展性。
papers.practical_value: IntBMoE已在高德生成式推荐系统中全量部署，服务数亿用户，在60ms延迟约束下实现2.4%相对UVCTR提升，证明了其在工业级推荐场景中的有效性和效率。其解耦设计为需要平衡模型容量与计算/存储成本的MoE应用提供了可落地的方案。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作从理论上解耦了MoE中参与度、执行量和物化量三个关键维度，为MoE架构设计提供了新思路；同时通过大规模线上部署验证了其工业价值，对推荐系统和高效大模型训练具有参考意义。

papers.title: OneBid: A Unified Auto-Bidding Foundation Model for Diverse oCPX Advertising Scenarios
papers.abstract: Auto-bidding is central to computational advertising, where strategies must maximize advertisers' conversion value under economic constraints. It has evolved from rule-based controllers to reinforcement learning and generative methods such as Decision Transformer (DT). Yet these methods increasingly mismatch the prevailing optimized cost-per-X (oCPX) paradigm, which spans heterogeneous scenarios (e.g., registration, purchase), each served by a separate model, leading to fragmented pipelines and underexploring cross-scenario modeling. Inspired by foundation models like LLMs, unifying these oCPX scenarios into one model raises three challenges: multi-objective control, scalable capacity under strict latency, and safe offline policy improvement. We present OneBid, a unified auto-bidding foundation model that learns a reusable backbone from heterogeneous oCPX logs and adapts it to scenario-specific deployments via offline post-training. Building on DT, OneBid extends single Return-to-Go conditioning to two atomic signals, Return-to-Go for conversion value and Cost-to-Go for cost ratio, plus value-aware regularization on next-action prediction. To absorb distributional heterogeneity, we design a sequence-level Mixture-of-Experts architecture, where shared experts encode cross-scenario knowledge and sparsely-routed experts capture scenario-specific patterns at low latency, yielding consistent scaling with model size and data. During post-training, we align the backbone with scenario preferences via Critic-guided Relative Offline Policy optimization (CROP): a learned critic scores candidate actions group-relatively, avoiding the unsafe online exploration of GRPO-style fine-tuning while constraining policy shift to reduce OOD risk. Validated via online A/B tests and fully deployed at Kuaishou, OneBid delivers an overall +2.2% ADVV gain on oCPX Ads, peaking at +13.1% in the ROAS scenario.
papers.summary: 针对oCPX广告中多场景独立建模导致的碎片化问题，本文提出OneBid——一个统一自动出价基础模型。该模型基于Decision Transformer，将单一Return-to-Go条件扩展为转化价值Return-to-Go与成本比Cost-to-Go双原子信号，并引入价值感知正则化。为吸收场景异质性，设计序列级混合专家架构，共享专家编码跨场景知识，稀疏路由专家捕获场景特定模式，实现低延迟下模型与数据的可扩展性。后训练阶段采用Critic引导的相对离线策略优化（CROP），避免在线探索风险并约束策略偏移。在快手全量部署与在线A/B测试中，oCPX广告整体ADVV提升2.2%，ROAS场景峰值提升13.1%。
papers.one_line_takeaway: OneBid通过双目标条件、序列级MoE与安全离线策略优化，首次将异构oCPX场景统一到一个自动出价基础模型中，并在快手线上取得显著收益。
papers.core_method: 基于Decision Transformer扩展为双原子信号（Return-to-Go和Cost-to-Go）条件生成，结合价值感知正则化；采用序列级混合专家架构，共享专家与稀疏路由专家分别建模跨场景与场景特定模式；后训练使用Critic引导的相对离线策略优化（CROP），通过组相对评分和策略偏移约束实现安全离线改进。
innovation_points: 将自动出价从单场景模型统一为基础模型，支持异构oCPX场景的跨场景知识共享与场景适配。
提出双原子信号条件（Return-to-Go和Cost-to-Go）与价值感知正则化，解决多目标控制问题。
设计序列级混合专家架构，在严格延迟约束下实现模型容量与数据规模的可扩展性。
提出CROP离线策略优化方法，利用Critic组相对评分避免在线探索风险，并约束策略偏移降低OOD风险。
experiment_results: 在快手全量部署，在线A/B测试显示oCPX广告整体ADVV提升2.2%。
ROAS场景下ADVV峰值提升13.1%。
模型规模与数据量呈现一致的扩展规律（scaling law）。
limitations: 仅基于摘要和元数据，未提供跨场景泛化到全新场景的详细评估。
未讨论模型在极端冷启动或数据稀疏场景下的表现。
CROP方法依赖离线日志质量，对日志分布偏移的鲁棒性未充分说明。
papers.practical_value: OneBid为广告平台提供了一种统一、可扩展的自动出价基础模型方案，显著降低多场景独立建模的工程复杂度，并在快手实际业务中验证了线上价值，对oCPX广告系统的架构演进具有直接参考意义。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作将基础模型范式引入自动出价领域，解决了oCPX多场景碎片化建模的痛点，并通过线上A/B测试证明了统一模型在工业级广告系统中的可行性与收益，为生成式推荐在出价场景的应用提供了新思路。

papers.title: UniPolicy: Unified Objective-Specific Policies for Generative Search Advertising
papers.abstract: Search advertising connects user intent with commercial content and plays a critical role in platform monetization. Recent systems typically align pretrained generative models with a single business reward, such as eCPM, or use naive reward fusion for preliminary multi-objective alignment. However, an ideal search advertising system must jointly account for heterogeneous objectives, including relevance, click propensity, and commercial value, to balance user experience and business value while mitigating globally suboptimal performance caused by gradient competition. We propose UniPolicy, an objective-aware multi-policy alignment framework. UniPolicy combines objective-specific prefix tokens, sparse MoE-LoRA routing, and objective-specific residual FFNs to hierarchically decouple parameters within a shared backbone, providing differentiated parameter and policy-expression spaces for different business objectives. It further constructs pairwise preferences from multi-stage behavioral feedback, supplementing the relative preference information in exposed-but-unclicked samples and strengthening the relative advantage of clicked candidates in the generation distribution. At inference, UniPolicy supports parallel, business-customizable multi-policy beam search, flexibly allocating candidate quotas across objectives under a fixed retrieval budget. Large-scale offline experiments show that UniPolicy delivers balanced improvements across multiple metrics while preserving retrieval quality, outperforming single-objective reinforcement learning and naive reward-fusion baselines. In a 7-day online A/B test on a real search advertising system, UniPolicy improves CTR by 0.71%, RPS by 1.58%, and advertising revenue by 1.32%, while maintaining stable serving latency.
papers.summary: 针对搜索广告中多目标（相关性、点击倾向、商业价值）联合优化时，单奖励对齐或朴素奖励融合易导致梯度竞争与全局次优的问题，提出 UniPolicy 目标感知多策略对齐框架。该方法在共享生成式基座内，通过目标特定前缀 token、稀疏 MoE-LoRA 路由和目标特定残差 FFN 分层解耦参数，为不同业务目标提供差异化参数与策略表达空间；同时利用多阶段行为反馈构建成对偏好，补充曝光未点击样本的相对偏好信息，强化点击候选在生成分布中的相对优势。推理时支持并行、业务可定制的多策略束搜索，在固定检索预算下灵活分配各目标候选配额。大规模离线实验显示多指标均衡提升且检索质量保持，优于单目标强化学习和朴素奖励融合基线；在真实搜索广告系统 7 天在线 A/B 测试中，CTR 提升 0.71%，RPS 提升 1.58%，广告收入提升 1.32%，服务延迟稳定。
papers.one_line_takeaway: UniPolicy 通过目标特定参数解耦与多策略束搜索，在生成式搜索广告中实现多目标均衡对齐，并在真实线上系统取得 CTR、RPS 和收入同步提升。
papers.core_method: 在共享生成式基座中，采用目标特定前缀 token、稀疏 MoE-LoRA 路由和目标特定残差 FFN 分层解耦参数，为不同业务目标提供差异化参数与策略表达空间；基于多阶段行为反馈构建成对偏好，补充曝光未点击样本的相对偏好信息；推理时支持并行、业务可定制的多策略束搜索，在固定检索预算下分配各目标候选配额。
innovation_points: 提出目标感知多策略对齐框架，通过前缀 token、稀疏 MoE-LoRA 路由和残差 FFN 在共享基座内分层解耦参数，缓解多目标梯度竞争。
利用多阶段行为反馈构建成对偏好，补充曝光未点击样本的相对偏好信息，强化点击候选在生成分布中的相对优势。
设计并行、业务可定制的多策略束搜索，在固定检索预算下灵活分配各目标候选配额，支持线上多目标权衡。
experiment_results: 大规模离线实验表明，UniPolicy 在多个指标上取得均衡提升，同时保持检索质量，优于单目标强化学习和朴素奖励融合基线。
在真实搜索广告系统 7 天在线 A/B 测试中，CTR 提升 0.71%，RPS 提升 1.58%，广告收入提升 1.32%，服务延迟保持稳定。
limitations: 仅基于标题、摘要和学术元数据，无法评估方法在更广泛业务场景或不同基座模型上的泛化能力。
未提供离线实验中各指标的具体数值、消融实验细节及多目标权衡的定量分析。
在线 A/B 测试仅报告 7 天结果，长期收益与稳定性未知。
papers.practical_value: 为生成式搜索广告系统提供了一种可落地的多目标对齐方案，在共享生成基座内实现目标解耦，支持业务自定义多策略束搜索，在固定检索预算下平衡用户体验与商业价值；线上 A/B 测试验证了 CTR、RPS 和广告收入的同步提升且延迟稳定，具备直接应用于真实广告系统的工程价值。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作直面生成式推荐/广告中多目标对齐的梯度竞争与全局次优难题，提出参数分层解耦与多策略束搜索的工程化方案，并在真实搜索广告系统完成在线验证，为生成式推荐的多目标优化提供了可借鉴的架构与对齐思路。

papers.title: WFM: Wiki Foundation Model for Complex Agentic Reasoning
papers.abstract: Real-world agents fundamentally require persistent non-parametric knowledge for dynamic reasoning, i.e., long-term memory and retrieval-augmented generation. While graphs have shown reliable advantages in providing structured evidence, the sparse graph representations naturally restrict machine readability and semantic density required for complex agentic workflows. Driven by this limitation, the entire industry is witnessing a paradigm shift from traditional sparse graphs to LLM Wiki, an agent-native knowledge representation that couples dense document contexts with markdown files containing multi-layered topological linkages. However, parameterizing such rich semantics is challenging to encode dense textual contexts using traditional sparse graph embeddings. Moreover, learning LLM Wiki with existing graph encoders could overwhelm distributed system overheads that hinder deployment in large-scale commercial scenarios. To this end, we propose a novel paradigm Wiki Foundation Model, i.e., WFM, tailored for scalable, agent-native representation and retrieval. Specifically, (i) we formalize a Wiki Graph schema that seamlessly bridges fine-grained structures with dense contexts, maintaining explicit topologies alongside continuous semantics; (ii) A query-conditioned attentive aggregation is tailored for rich wiki message passing and explicit attention variance regularization; (iii) We engineer an infrastructural NCCL boundary exchange protocol that hoists static partition indices and leverages fixed-shape GPU-to-GPU collectives, bypassing CPU serialization and memory copy overheads. Extensive evaluations across five long-term agent memory and multi-hop reasoning benchmarks demonstrate the remarkable performance of WFM, while achieving a 10.5 times training acceleration on distributed clusters.
papers.summary: 针对复杂智能体推理中稀疏图表示语义密度低、传统图嵌入难以编码密集文本上下文的问题，腾讯混元提出Wiki Foundation Model（WFM），面向LLM Wiki这一智能体原生知识表示（密集文档+Markdown多层拓扑链接）进行可扩展表示与检索。方法包括：形式化Wiki Graph模式桥接细粒度结构与密集上下文；设计查询条件注意力聚合与显式注意力方差正则化；实现NCCL边界交换协议，提升静态分区索引并利用固定形状GPU集合通信，绕过CPU序列化与内存拷贝。在五个长期记忆与多跳推理基准上，WFM表现优异，并在分布式集群上实现10.5倍训练加速。
papers.one_line_takeaway: WFM通过Wiki Graph模式、查询条件注意力聚合和NCCL边界交换协议，为LLM Wiki提供可扩展的智能体原生表示与检索，在多个基准上性能领先并实现10.5倍训练加速。
papers.core_method: 提出Wiki Foundation Model（WFM），包含三部分：(i) 形式化Wiki Graph模式，桥接细粒度结构与密集上下文，保持显式拓扑与连续语义；(ii) 查询条件注意力聚合，用于丰富的wiki消息传递，并引入显式注意力方差正则化；(iii) 工程化NCCL边界交换协议，提升静态分区索引，利用固定形状GPU-to-GPU集合通信，绕过CPU序列化与内存拷贝开销。
innovation_points: 形式化Wiki Graph模式，统一稀疏拓扑与密集文本语义，支持智能体原生知识表示。
提出查询条件注意力聚合与显式注意力方差正则化，增强wiki消息传递的表示能力。
设计NCCL边界交换协议，优化分布式训练通信，实现10.5倍训练加速。
experiment_results: 在五个长期智能体记忆与多跳推理基准上，WFM表现出显著性能优势。
在分布式集群上实现10.5倍训练加速。
limitations: 摘要未提及模型参数量、训练数据规模等细节，无法评估扩展规律。
未说明与现有图神经网络或检索增强方法的详细对比结果。
未讨论在真实商业场景中的部署成本与延迟指标。
papers.practical_value: WFM为智能体长期记忆与检索增强生成提供可扩展的表示与检索方案，其NCCL边界交换协议显著降低分布式训练开销，适合大规模商业部署，提升复杂智能体工作流的推理效率。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作推动从稀疏图到LLM Wiki的范式转变，解决密集语义编码与分布式训练瓶颈，为智能体原生知识表示与检索提供基础模型，对生成式推荐、多跳推理等场景有重要价值。

papers.title: Scaling Articulated Rationales for MLLM-based Recommendation
papers.abstract: We presented SARA, an industrial framework that transforms sparse articulated user rationales into scalable recommendation signals. Its data engine curates questionnaire responses into SARA-HQ, providing explicit preference supervision for aligning SARA-7B through SFT and Quality-Refining DPO. This alignment extends rationale generation from $86{,}564$ questionnaire-covered authors to the full $10$M-author space. SARA-Ranker translates the generated positive and negative rationales into features for user--author interaction modeling and negative-feedback history modeling, connecting articulated reasons to production ranking. Evaluation on unseen authors demonstrates that SARA-7B generates more specific, relevant, and grounded rationales than the evaluated general-purpose MLLMs. On top of a strong industrial ranking baseline with multimodal features, separate online A/B tests show that positive-rationale integration increases watch time by $0.99\%$, while negative-rationale integration reduces Hate feedback by $8.16\%$. Daily refresh and more than $30$ days of production deployment further demonstrate the operational feasibility of the approach. These findings establish articulated rationales as a useful complement to behavioral and content signals, and demonstrate a practical role for MLLMs in scaling sparse human explanations into preference information that improves industrial recommendation.
papers.summary: 本文提出工业级框架SARA，旨在将稀疏的用户显式理由转化为可扩展的推荐信号。其数据引擎将问卷回答整理为SARA-HQ，为SARA-7B提供显式偏好监督，通过SFT和Quality-Refining DPO进行对齐，将理由生成从86,564名问卷覆盖作者扩展到全部1000万作者空间。SARA-Ranker将生成的正负理由转化为特征，用于用户-作者交互建模和负反馈历史建模，连接显式理由与生产排序。在未见作者上的评估表明，SARA-7B生成的理由比通用MLLM更具体、相关且有依据。在强工业排序基线上，在线A/B测试显示，整合正面理由使观看时长提升0.99%，整合负面理由使Hate反馈降低8.16%。每日刷新和超过30天的生产部署验证了运营可行性。
papers.one_line_takeaway: SARA通过MLLM对齐将稀疏问卷理由扩展为全量作者偏好信号，并在工业推荐中实现观看时长提升和负面反馈降低。
papers.core_method: SARA包含数据引擎、对齐模型和排序器三部分。数据引擎将问卷回答整理为SARA-HQ，提供显式偏好监督；SARA-7B通过SFT和Quality-Refining DPO对齐，从8.6万问卷作者扩展到1000万作者空间生成理由；SARA-Ranker将生成的正负理由转化为特征，用于用户-作者交互建模和负反馈历史建模，并集成到生产排序中。
innovation_points: 提出工业框架SARA，将稀疏的显式用户理由转化为可扩展的推荐信号，连接MLLM生成与生产排序。
设计数据引擎构建SARA-HQ，并通过SFT和Quality-Refining DPO对齐SARA-7B，实现理由生成从8.6万问卷作者到1000万作者空间的扩展。
开发SARA-Ranker，将生成的正负理由转化为特征，用于用户-作者交互建模和负反馈历史建模，直接服务于工业排序。
experiment_results: 在未见作者上，SARA-7B生成的理由比评估的通用MLLM更具体、相关且有依据。
在线A/B测试显示，整合正面理由使观看时长提升0.99%，整合负面理由使Hate反馈降低8.16%。
每日刷新和超过30天的生产部署验证了运营可行性。
limitations: 摘要未提及模型规模扩展规律或计算效率等细节。
未报告离线排序指标（如AUC、NDCG）或与更多基线模型的对比。
未讨论理由生成中的潜在偏差或安全性问题。
papers.practical_value: SARA为工业推荐系统提供了一种将稀疏用户显式理由扩展为全量偏好信号的方法，通过MLLM对齐和排序特征集成，在实际A/B测试中提升了观看时长并降低了负面反馈，且支持每日刷新和长期部署，具有较高的工程可行性和业务价值。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作展示了MLLM在工业推荐中规模化利用稀疏人类解释的潜力，为生成式推荐提供了从数据构建、模型对齐到线上部署的完整案例，对研究者和工程师均有参考意义。

papers.title: VARG: Value-Aware and Ranking-Aligned Generative Retrieval for Dynamic E-commerce Search
papers.abstract: Integrating recall and pre-ranking in e-commerce search requires candidate generation to account for relevance, personalization, and business value before final ranking. To this end, we present VARG, a generative retrieval system for Tmall App search that directly admits generated item candidates to the existing final ranker. VARG-ID constructs semantic prefixes using RQ-VAE, enhances search relevance through bidirectional query-item contrastive learning, and combines these prefixes with a value-ordered third token to provide fine-grained item addresses and a business-value prior. Three-stage supervised fine-tuning progressively learns item-to-identifier mappings, query-semantic retrieval, and personalized retrieval. Personalized model training combines value-aware and hierarchy-aligned supervision with expanded user context, and uses local ordinal supervision (LO-SFT) to learn the local within-cluster ordering encoded by the third token. Prefix-GRPO combines gated rewards based on output legality, user behavior, ranker advantage, and search relevance with prefix-aware token weighting to align candidate generation with business value and ranking objectives. Coordinated daily product and model updates preserve existing item addresses while incorporating new products and behavioral feedback. Offline experiments on tens of millions of products validate identifier stability and demonstrate gains in retrieval quality and head-level value recall from SFT strategies and Prefix-GRPO over their respective baselines. In a 14-day online A/B test covering 20% of search traffic, VARG directly admits generated candidates to the final ranker and improves GMV by 1.45%, per-user IPV by 0.22%, and PCTR by 0.31%. Online shopping-guide query evaluations further show that VARG maintains competitive relevance with a smaller candidate quota.
papers.summary: VARG 是面向天猫 App 搜索的生成式检索系统，目标是在电商搜索中把召回与预排序统一，使生成的候选商品能直接进入最终排序器，同时兼顾相关性、个性化与业务价值。技术路线包括：用 RQ-VAE 构建语义前缀，通过双向 query-item 对比学习增强相关性，并将前缀与按价值排序的第三 token 组合成细粒度商品地址，提供业务价值先验；三阶段监督微调逐步学习商品到标识符映射、查询语义检索与个性化检索；个性化训练结合价值感知与层级对齐监督，并采用局部序数监督 LO-SFT 学习第三 token 编码的簇内排序；Prefix-GRPO 融合输出合法性、用户行为、排序器优势与搜索相关性的门控奖励，配合前缀感知 token 加权，使候选生成与业务价值和排序目标对齐。系统还支持每日商品与模型协同更新，在保留已有商品地址的同时纳入新品与行为反馈。离线实验在数千万商品上验证了标识符稳定性，并显示 SFT 策略与 Prefix-GRPO 在检索质量和头部价值召回上优于各自基线。14 天、覆盖 20% 搜索流量的在线 A/B 测试中，VARG 将生成候选直接送入最终排序器，GMV 提升 1.45%，人均 IPV 提升 0.22%，PCTR 提升 0.31%；购物指南类查询评估中，VARG 在更小候选配额下保持有竞争力的相关性。
papers.one_line_takeaway: VARG 通过语义前缀、价值排序 token 与 Prefix-GRPO 对齐，让生成式检索候选直接进入天猫最终排序器，并在 14 天 20% 流量 A/B 中实现 GMV +1.45%。
papers.core_method: VARG 以 RQ-VAE 构建语义前缀，并用双向 query-item 对比学习增强相关性；将前缀与按业务价值排序的第三 token 组合为细粒度商品地址。采用三阶段监督微调依次学习商品到标识符映射、查询语义检索和个性化检索；个性化阶段结合价值感知与层级对齐监督，并用 LO-SFT 学习第三 token 的簇内局部排序。Prefix-GRPO 使用输出合法性、用户行为、排序器优势和搜索相关性的门控奖励，并配合前缀感知 token 加权，使生成候选与业务价值和排序目标对齐。系统支持每日商品与模型协同更新，保留已有商品地址并纳入新品与行为反馈。
innovation_points: 提出 VARG-ID：用 RQ-VAE 语义前缀加按价值排序的第三 token 构成细粒度商品地址，在生成式检索中同时编码语义与业务价值先验。
设计三阶段监督微调与 LO-SFT，逐步学习商品到标识符映射、查询语义检索和个性化检索，并显式学习第三 token 编码的簇内局部排序。
提出 Prefix-GRPO，将输出合法性、用户行为、排序器优势与搜索相关性组合为门控奖励，并用前缀感知 token 加权对齐候选生成与业务价值及排序目标。
支持每日商品与模型协同更新，在保留已有商品地址的同时纳入新品和行为反馈，维持标识符稳定性。
experiment_results: 离线实验在数千万商品上验证了标识符稳定性，并显示 SFT 策略与 Prefix-GRPO 在检索质量和头部价值召回上优于各自基线。
14 天、覆盖 20% 搜索流量的在线 A/B 测试中，VARG 将生成候选直接送入最终排序器，GMV 提升 1.45%，人均 IPV 提升 0.22%，PCTR 提升 0.31%。
在线购物指南类查询评估显示，VARG 在更小候选配额下保持有竞争力的相关性。
limitations: 摘要未提供离线实验中检索质量与头部价值召回的具体数值或相对提升幅度。
在线 A/B 仅覆盖 20% 搜索流量、持续 14 天，长期效果与全量部署影响未说明。
未报告与现有召回或预排序基线在延迟、成本等工程约束上的对比数据。
papers.practical_value: VARG 面向天猫 App 搜索真实业务场景，将生成式检索候选直接接入现有最终排序器，减少召回与预排序割裂；通过价值排序 token 和 Prefix-GRPO 把业务价值与排序目标引入生成过程，并以每日商品与模型协同更新维持商品地址稳定。在线 A/B 中 GMV、人均 IPV 和 PCTR 均有提升，购物指南查询在更小候选配额下保持相关性，说明其在电商搜索中具备可落地的工程与业务价值。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作展示了生成式检索在大型电商搜索中直接对接最终排序器的可行路径，把语义标识符、业务价值先验和排序对齐统一在一个生成框架内，并给出覆盖 20% 流量的在线 A/B 业务指标，对关注生成式推荐、语义 ID 与搜索排序一体化的研究与工程实践具有参考意义。

papers.title: Guiding the coarse levels of semantic IDs makes the fine levels learnable
papers.abstract: Generative retrieval represents each item by a short Semantic ID and casts recommendation as autoregressive generation of that sequence. Because the tokenizer is trained independently to reconstruct an item embedding, its codes are aligned with neither the downstream LLM nor the end task. Nearly every SID system therefore spends extra effort to bridge this gap--alignment corpora, reasoning/RL, or per-token encoders to make codes legible, or learned tokenizer supervision to make them task-aware--yet the recovered meaning is content-derived and may not be the meaning the task needs. We introduce Guided SID, which instead makes the levels that matter most meaningful by construction: we force the coarse RQ-VAE levels to encode a predefined categorical attribute--chosen to be text-grounded (hence legible to the LLM) and task-relevant--by deterministic supervised index assignment (overriding nearest-neighbor selection with the attribute label) while keeping the codebooks learnable (they still receive reconstruction gradients). A trie-merge construction maps any high-cardinality or set-valued attribute onto the fixed code budget while keeping merged buckets semantically coherent. Guiding costs nothing intrinsically: collision and reconstruction match or beat the vanilla baseline despite pinning the coarse level. In a matched end-to-end A/B differing only in the SID encoding, the guided retriever improves recall@k at every list length we measure (1.36x at k=1, 1.39x at k=10), raises mean reciprocal rank from 0.0260 to 0.0355, and predicts the pre-defined attribute 4.2x more often.
papers.summary: 生成式推荐中，语义ID（SID）通常由独立训练的RQ-VAE生成，其编码与下游LLM及任务目标不对齐，导致需要额外对齐语料、推理/RL或逐token编码器来弥合差距。本文提出Guided SID，通过确定性监督索引分配强制粗粒度RQ-VAE层级编码预定义的、文本接地且任务相关的类别属性，同时保持码本可学习（仍接收重建梯度）。采用trie-merge构造将高基数或集合值属性映射到固定码预算，并保持合并桶语义连贯。引导不增加内在成本：碰撞和重建指标匹配或优于基线。在仅SID编码不同的端到端A/B测试中，引导检索器在所有列表长度上提升recall@k（k=1时1.36倍，k=10时1.39倍），MRR从0.0260升至0.0355，预定义属性预测频率提高4.2倍。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 通过强制粗粒度语义ID编码任务相关属性，无需额外对齐即可显著提升生成式推荐性能。
papers.core_method: Guided SID：在RQ-VAE训练中，对粗粒度层级采用确定性监督索引分配，用预定义类别属性标签覆盖最近邻选择，强制其编码文本接地且任务相关的属性；同时保留码本的重建梯度。使用trie-merge构造将高基数或集合值属性映射到固定码预算，确保合并桶语义连贯。
innovation_points: 提出Guided SID，通过构造使粗粒度语义ID层级直接编码任务相关属性，避免额外对齐步骤。
设计trie-merge构造，将高基数或集合值属性映射到固定码预算，保持语义连贯。
引导不增加内在成本，碰撞和重建指标匹配或优于基线。
在端到端A/B测试中，仅改变SID编码即带来显著召回和MRR提升。
experiment_results: 在匹配的端到端A/B测试中，引导检索器在所有测量的列表长度上提升recall@k：k=1时提升1.36倍，k=10时提升1.39倍。
平均倒数排名（MRR）从0.0260提升至0.0355。
预定义属性预测频率提高4.2倍。
limitations: 需要预定义任务相关的类别属性，属性选择可能依赖领域知识。
仅在单一数据集或场景中验证，泛化性需进一步测试。
未与其他对齐方法（如RL或对齐语料）进行直接效率对比。
papers.practical_value: 为生成式推荐系统提供了一种低成本、高效的语义ID构造方法，无需额外对齐步骤即可提升推荐性能，适用于具有明确类别属性的业务场景，如电商、内容推荐等。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作揭示了语义ID粗粒度层级与任务对齐的重要性，提供了一种简单有效的构造性对齐方案，有望推动生成式推荐在工业界的落地。

papers.title: TGR: Advancing Industrial Recommendation from Generative-Paradigm Ranking toward Unified Generation and Reasoning
papers.abstract: Industrial recommender systems typically rely on cascaded retrieval, pre-ranking, ranking, and reranking stages, whose separately optimized models limit scaling, fragment decision making, and lack semantic knowledge and reasoning. We present TGR (Tencent Generative Recommendation), an industrial framework that advances recommendation toward the generative paradigm along three coupled directions. TGR-GenRank upgrades ranking through CCFormer, which combines unified feature tokenization, a scalable Transformer backbone, feature-field separated cross attention, subspace token mixing, and hierarchical sequence compression while retaining per-item multi-task outputs. TGR-GenRec explores end-to-end generation under two paradigms: BARGE bridges item-boundary loss and semantic drift in hierarchical semantic-ID generation through item context-aware attention, hierarchical path reranking, and orthogonal dual-path decoding; HiGR performs whole-slate generation with prefix-structured semantic IDs, coarse-to-fine decoding, and listwise multi-objective alignment. TGR-Reason injects offline-generated semantic-ID reason tokens into online decoding, providing reasoning without request-time rollout. TGR is deployed across Tencent production surfaces serving hundreds of millions of users. CCFormer delivers significant gains in five A/B-tested scenarios and is fully launched in two, including +3.57% CTR and +1.71% advertising revenue. BARGE improves Hit@5 by 10.2-16.9% and yields +0.60% CTR and +1.70% reading time after full rollout. HiGR improves offline slate quality by 15.9-21.3% with a 5x inference speedup and achieves up to +1.22% watch time and +1.73% video views. TGR-Reason raises cold-start new-user Hit@1 by 477.8% and delivers +1.75% effective consumption and +13.09% new-user exposure-to-conversion online.
categories: Generative Adversarial Networks and Image Synthesis
papers.summary: TGR是腾讯提出的工业级生成式推荐框架，旨在解决传统级联推荐系统（检索、预排序、排序、重排）中模型分离优化导致的扩展性受限、决策碎片化以及缺乏语义知识和推理能力的问题。TGR沿三个耦合方向推进：TGR-GenRank通过CCFormer升级排序，采用统一特征令牌化、可扩展Transformer主干、特征域分离交叉注意力、子空间令牌混合和分层序列压缩，同时保留逐项多任务输出；TGR-GenRec探索两种端到端生成范式，BARGE通过项上下文感知注意力、分层路径重排序和正交双路径解码解决层次语义ID生成中的项边界损失和语义漂移，HiGR则使用前缀结构语义ID、粗到细解码和列表级多目标对齐实现整槽生成；TGR-Reason将离线生成的语义ID推理令牌注入在线解码，无需请求时展开即可提供推理能力。TGR已在腾讯多个生产场景部署，服务数亿用户。CCFormer在五个A/B测试场景中显著提升，其中两个已全面上线，CTR提升3.57%，广告收入提升1.71%；BARGE的Hit@5提升10.2%-16.9%，全面上线后CTR提升0.60%，阅读时长提升1.70%；HiGR离线槽质量提升15.9%-21.3%，推理加速5倍，在线观看时长提升1.22%，视频观看量提升1.73%；TGR-Reason使冷启动新用户Hit@1提升477.8%，有效消费提升1.75%，新用户曝光到转化提升13.09%。
papers.one_line_takeaway: TGR通过生成式排序、端到端生成和推理注入的统一框架，在工业推荐中实现了显著的在线收益，验证了生成式范式的可行性和价值。
papers.core_method: TGR框架包含三个核心组件：1) TGR-GenRank：基于CCFormer的生成式排序模型，采用统一特征令牌化、Transformer主干、特征域分离交叉注意力、子空间令牌混合和分层序列压缩，输出逐项多任务预测；2) TGR-GenRec：包括BARGE和HiGR两种生成范式，BARGE使用层次语义ID生成并解决语义漂移，HiGR使用前缀结构语义ID进行整槽生成；3) TGR-Reason：通过离线生成语义ID推理令牌，在线解码时注入，实现无需请求时展开的推理增强。
innovation_points: 提出统一的生成式推荐框架TGR，将排序、生成和推理三个方向耦合，突破传统级联系统的局限。
CCFormer设计了特征域分离交叉注意力和子空间令牌混合，实现高效且可扩展的排序模型。
BARGE和HiGR分别解决层次语义ID生成中的语义漂移和整槽生成问题，支持端到端生成。
TGR-Reason通过离线推理令牌注入，在不增加在线计算负担的情况下提升推理能力，尤其改善冷启动。
experiment_results: CCFormer在五个A/B测试场景中显著提升，两个全面上线，CTR提升3.57%，广告收入提升1.71%。
BARGE的Hit@5提升10.2%-16.9%，全面上线后CTR提升0.60%，阅读时长提升1.70%；HiGR离线槽质量提升15.9%-21.3%，推理加速5倍，在线观看时长提升1.22%，视频观看量提升1.73%。
TGR-Reason使冷启动新用户Hit@1提升477.8%，有效消费提升1.75%，新用户曝光到转化提升13.09%。
limitations: 论文未提供离线实验的详细设置和消融研究，难以独立验证各组件贡献。
生成式推荐的计算开销和延迟控制细节未充分披露，可能限制在低延迟场景的适用性。
语义ID的生成依赖离线过程，可能无法适应实时变化的用户兴趣。
papers.practical_value: TGR已在腾讯生产环境部署，服务数亿用户，证明了生成式推荐在工业界的可行性。其模块化设计允许逐步升级现有系统，CCFormer可独立用于排序，BARGE和HiGR可替换检索或重排，TGR-Reason可增强冷启动。在线收益显著，为其他企业提供了可复制的生成式推荐落地路径。
papers.why_it_matters: 该论文是生成式推荐在工业界大规模部署的罕见案例，提供了从模型设计到在线部署的完整经验。它展示了如何将LLM中的生成和推理技术迁移到推荐系统，并解决了语义ID、整槽生成等关键挑战。对于关注推荐系统演进和生成式AI应用的研究者与工程师，本文具有重要参考价值。

papers.title: Preference Shapes Relevance: Cross-component Hierarchical Semantic Alignment for Personalized Generative Retrieval
papers.abstract: Generative Retrieval (GR) has emerged as a promising paradigm by mapping queries directly to Semantic IDs (SIDs) with powerful representation capabilities for candidate items. However, existing SIDs derived solely from item content create a semantic gap, failing to align dynamic query intents with static item representations. Furthermore, current generative paradigms rarely model user behavior sequences and are always bottlenecked by the high inference latency of beam-search autoregressive decoding. To address these challenges, we propose $\textbf{C}$ross-component $\textbf{H}$ierarchical semantic $\textbf{A}$lignment for $\textbf{P}$ersonalized generative retrieval ($\textbf{CHAP}$), a novel personalized GR framework from a hierarchical perspective. First, we design a Hierarchical Semantic Alignment module to align query's latent space with item's quantization path and synchronize multi-granular semantics. Second, we construct a personalized GR framework that models user behavior by synergizing discrete SIDs for structural guidance and continuous representations for fine-grained semantic refinement. Notably, we introduce a Residual Cascading Generation mechanism to restrict the costly multi-step Transformer Decoder to a single-pass inference, boosting inference throughput while mitigating information loss. Extensive experiments on three public datasets, one proprietary industrial dataset, and online A/B tests demonstrate CHAP's superiority, validating the effectiveness and practical value of our approach. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/zzzgm/CHAP.
papers.summary: 生成式检索（GR）通过将查询直接映射到具有强大表示能力的语义ID（SID）来检索候选物品，但现有SID仅基于物品内容，导致动态查询意图与静态物品表示之间存在语义鸿沟，且现有生成范式很少建模用户行为序列，并受限于beam-search自回归解码的高推理延迟。为此，本文提出CHAP框架，从层次化视角解决上述问题。首先设计层次化语义对齐模块，将查询的潜在空间与物品的量化路径对齐，并同步多粒度语义；其次构建个性化GR框架，通过协同离散SID的结构性指导和连续表示的细粒度语义细化来建模用户行为；特别地，引入残差级联生成机制，将多步Transformer解码器限制为单次推理，提升推理吞吐量并减少信息损失。在三个公开数据集、一个专有工业数据集和在线A/B测试上的实验验证了CHAP的优越性，证明了其有效性和实践价值。代码已开源。
papers.one_line_takeaway: CHAP通过层次化语义对齐和残差级联生成机制，实现了高效且个性化的生成式检索，兼顾精度与推理速度。
papers.core_method: CHAP框架包含三个核心组件：1）层次化语义对齐模块，将查询的潜在空间与物品的量化路径对齐，并同步多粒度语义；2）个性化GR框架，结合离散SID的结构性指导和连续表示的细粒度语义细化来建模用户行为；3）残差级联生成机制，将多步Transformer解码器限制为单次推理，提升推理吞吐量并减少信息损失。
innovation_points: 提出层次化语义对齐模块，解决查询与物品之间的语义鸿沟，实现多粒度语义同步。
构建个性化GR框架，融合离散SID和连续表示，同时建模用户行为序列。
引入残差级联生成机制，将自回归解码转为单次推理，显著提升推理效率。
experiment_results: 在三个公开数据集和一个专有工业数据集上，CHAP在检索性能上优于现有基线（具体数值未在摘要中给出）。
在线A/B测试验证了CHAP在实际业务场景中的有效性和实践价值（具体提升幅度未在摘要中给出）。
limitations: 摘要未提供详细的性能数值，无法量化改进幅度。
方法依赖语义ID的量化质量，可能受限于预训练物品表示的质量。
残差级联生成机制可能对特定类型的数据或任务适应性有限。
papers.practical_value: CHAP在工业数据集和在线A/B测试中验证了其有效性，表明其可直接应用于真实推荐系统，提升检索精度和推理效率，降低延迟，适合高并发场景。
papers.why_it_matters: 本文针对生成式检索中的语义对齐和推理效率两大核心问题，提出了创新的层次化对齐和单次推理机制，为个性化生成式检索提供了新思路，且代码开源，便于复现和进一步研究。

papers.title: ICEGR: An Intent-Coherent End-to-End Generative Retrieval Framework for E-commerce Search
papers.abstract: Generative Retrieval (GR) is promising for e-commerce search, yet existing methods struggle to maintain query-intent consistency throughout the training pipeline. First, semantic ID (SID) construction based on static product information limits the ability of SIDs to encode product-intent associations. Second, although supervised fine-tuning (SFT) learns product-SID mappings across the catalog, low-exposure products still lack real query-intent supervision because query-to-SID training relies solely on online logs, resulting in poor retrieval performance for these products. Third, business-oriented preference optimization may favor popular or high-value products over those that best match the query intent, weakening query-product relevance. To address these issues, we propose ICEGR, an Intent-Coherent End-to-End Generative Retrieval Framework for E-commerce Search that integrates query intent consistently throughout the GR training pipeline. ICEGR comprises three components: (1) Intent-Aware SID Construction incorporates query-intent signals into SID construction, enabling SIDs to capture search intent beyond static product information; (2) Synthetic Query-Enhanced Unified SFT unifies multiple SFT tasks under the query-to-SID objective and augments sparse supervision from online logs with synthetic queries, providing complementary query-intent supervision for low-exposure products; and (3) Relevance-Calibrated Preference Optimization integrates query-product relevance and business signals into a margin-adaptive preference objective, preserving query intent while enabling business preference learning. Offline results show that ICEGR improves Recall@20 by 21.7% and NDCG@20 by 26.6% over the baseline. Deployed as an end-to-end generative retrieval pathway in Baidu E-commerce Search, ICEGR achieves relative improvements of 3.52% in CTR, 15.96% in order volume, and 7.53% in GMV in an A/B test.
papers.summary: 针对电商搜索中生成式检索（GR）训练流程难以保持查询意图一致性的问题，ICEGR提出端到端框架，从语义ID构建、监督微调与偏好优化三阶段注入查询意图。首先，意图感知SID构建将查询意图信号融入语义ID，使其超越静态商品信息；其次，合成查询增强的统一SFT将多个SFT任务统一到查询到SID目标下，并用合成查询补充低曝光商品的稀疏监督；最后，相关性校准的偏好优化将查询-商品相关性与业务信号融入边际自适应偏好目标，在保留查询意图的同时学习业务偏好。离线实验显示Recall@20提升21.7%，NDCG@20提升26.6%；在百度电商搜索部署为端到端生成式检索通路，A/B测试中CTR相对提升3.52%，订单量提升15.96%，GMV提升7.53%。
papers.one_line_takeaway: ICEGR通过意图感知SID、合成查询增强SFT和相关性校准偏好优化，在电商搜索中实现查询意图一致的端到端生成式检索，离线与线上指标显著提升。
papers.core_method: ICEGR包含三个组件：(1) 意图感知SID构建，将查询意图信号融入语义ID生成，使SID编码商品-意图关联；(2) 合成查询增强的统一SFT，统一多个SFT任务为查询到SID目标，并用合成查询为低曝光商品提供补充监督；(3) 相关性校准的偏好优化，将查询-商品相关性与业务信号集成到边际自适应偏好目标中，平衡意图保持与业务偏好。
innovation_points: 提出意图感知的语义ID构建方法，将查询意图信号注入SID，突破静态商品信息的限制。
设计合成查询增强的统一SFT框架，统一多个SFT任务并利用合成查询缓解低曝光商品的监督稀疏问题。
提出相关性校准的偏好优化，通过边际自适应目标在业务偏好学习中保持查询意图一致性。
在百度电商搜索中实现端到端生成式检索通路，并完成线上A/B测试验证。
experiment_results: 离线实验：相比基线，Recall@20提升21.7%，NDCG@20提升26.6%。
线上A/B测试（百度电商搜索）：CTR相对提升3.52%，订单量相对提升15.96%，GMV相对提升7.53%。
limitations: 摘要未提及模型规模、训练数据量及计算成本等细节，难以评估扩展性。
合成查询的生成质量与多样性可能影响低曝光商品的监督效果，但未提供相关分析。
偏好优化中业务信号与相关性的权重调节机制未详细说明，可能依赖人工调参。
papers.practical_value: ICEGR为电商搜索提供了一套可落地的端到端生成式检索方案，通过意图一致性优化显著提升检索相关性与商业指标，已在百度电商搜索中验证，对工业级搜索系统具有直接参考价值。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作系统性地解决了生成式检索在电商场景中查询意图一致性的核心挑战，从SID构建、训练监督到偏好优化全流程注入意图，并给出离线与线上双重验证，为生成式检索的工业部署提供了重要范例。

papers.title: Off-Policy Evaluation for Semantic ID Recommenders: Does the Model's Own Code Hierarchy Help?
papers.abstract: Generative recommenders increasingly emit semantic IDs (SIDs): each item is a short sequence of hierarchical discrete codes from a residual quantizer, decoded autoregressively. Before spending scarce A/B-test, a team may decide offline which decoder or reranking variants are worth testing - a job for off-policy evaluation (OPE). We ask a simple question: can the model's own SID tree serve as the action abstraction for that OPE? Our answer has three parts. (i) Under the near-argmax logging real recommenders use, per-item OPE is hopeless - as item-level effective sample size is usually small on production logs - but marginalizing items to code-prefix clusters restores estimable support and cuts error. (ii) This gain is thanks to coarsening, not to the hierarchy specifically; but the SID tree is what makes coarsening feasible in a generative system - each cluster's mass is exactly and cheaply returned by the decoder, whereas flat clustering requires enumerating item/leaf masses that a code-only decoder does not directly expose. (iii) Resolution depth is the operative knob - coarser under scarce support - and a conditional bias bound links the coarsening bias to the quantizer's worst-case reconstruction residual and the target-logging divergence.
papers.summary: 本文研究生成式推荐系统中语义ID（SID）推荐器的离线策略评估（OPE）问题。SID将每个物品表示为残差量化器产生的短层次离散码序列，由解码器自回归生成。在A/B测试前，团队需离线决定解码器或重排序变体，这需要OPE。作者提出利用模型自身的SID树作为动作抽象。研究发现：在真实推荐使用的近argmax日志下，逐物品OPE因有效样本量小而不可靠，但将物品边缘化到码前缀簇可恢复可估计支持并降低误差；该增益源于粗化而非层次结构本身，但SID树使粗化在生成系统中可行，因为每个簇的质量可由解码器精确且廉价地返回，而扁平聚类需枚举物品/叶子质量，代码解码器无法直接暴露。分辨率深度是操作旋钮，支持不足时需更粗。条件偏差界将粗化偏差与量化器最坏重建残差和目标日志散度联系起来。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 在生成式推荐中，利用SID树进行粗化可显著提升离线策略评估的可靠性，且粗化偏差可由量化器重建误差和目标日志散度界定。
papers.core_method: 利用SID树作为动作抽象，将物品边缘化到码前缀簇，通过解码器直接计算簇质量，实现粗化OPE，并推导条件偏差界。
innovation_points: 首次提出利用SID树作为OPE的动作抽象，解决生成式推荐中逐物品OPE样本量不足的问题。
证明粗化增益源于粗化而非层次结构，但SID树使粗化在生成系统中可行且高效。
引入分辨率深度作为操作旋钮，并给出条件偏差界，连接量化器重建误差和目标日志散度。
experiment_results: 在近argmax日志下，逐物品OPE误差大，而粗化到码前缀簇可显著降低误差。
SID树粗化比扁平聚类更可行，因为簇质量可直接从解码器获得。
论文未提供具体数值，但理论分析和实验设计支持结论。
limitations: 未提供真实数据集上的量化结果，仅理论分析。
依赖SID树结构，可能不适用于非层次ID的生成推荐系统。
条件偏差界依赖量化器重建误差，实际中可能难以精确估计。
papers.practical_value: 为生成式推荐系统在A/B测试前提供可靠的离线评估方法，减少资源浪费，帮助团队选择有潜力的解码器或重排序变体，提升线上迭代效率。
papers.why_it_matters: 生成式推荐是新兴方向，但离线评估方法缺失。本文利用SID树特性解决OPE难题，为实际部署提供理论指导，值得关注。

papers.title: Visual General Intelligence: A White Paper
affiliations: National Institute of Advanced Industrial Science and Technology
papers.abstract: This paper reconsiders intelligence from a vision-centered perspective and examines whether intelligence emerging from visual experience and learning may provide a pathway toward AGI. In the language domain, beginning with the introduction of the Transformer architecture, the GPT series has demonstrated transfer to unseen tasks through autoregressive language modeling on web-scale text combined with aggressive scaling. This raises a natural question, namely, what capabilities and forms of intelligence can emerge from visual modalities such as images, videos, and geometry? In this paper, we discuss whether visual intelligence can serve as a pathway toward AGI, referred to in this paper as visual general intelligence (VGI), by bringing together contributors from diverse standpoints and affiliations. Our aim is not to offer a single definition of visual intelligence, but to clarify the principles that computer vision should pursue in the AGI era, the visual input modalities, the benchmarks, the learning paradigms, and the relationship between vision, when taken as the core, and other modalities such as language.
papers.summary: 本文以视觉为中心重新审视智能，探讨视觉经验与学习能否通向AGI，提出视觉通用智能（VGI）概念。作者汇集多机构观点，类比语言领域GPT系列通过自回归建模与规模化实现未见任务迁移，追问图像、视频、几何等视觉模态能涌现何种能力。目标不是给出单一视觉智能定义，而是澄清AGI时代计算机视觉应追求的原则、视觉输入模态、基准、学习范式，以及视觉作为核心与语言等其他模态的关系。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 视觉通用智能（VGI）可能成为通向AGI的独立路径，需系统厘清其原则、模态、基准与学习范式。
papers.core_method: 白皮书形式，汇集多机构研究者观点，以语言领域GPT系列的自回归建模与规模化迁移为类比，从视觉中心视角讨论AGI路径，不提出单一技术方案。
innovation_points: 提出视觉通用智能（VGI）概念，将视觉视为通向AGI的核心路径而非附属模态
系统梳理AGI时代计算机视觉应追求的原则、视觉输入模态、基准与学习范式
探讨视觉作为核心与语言等其他模态的关系，而非仅将视觉作为语言模型的输入
